I'd go even further to say they welcome the misery so they can keep folks down and dependent. And that's why I'm running for Senate. We Republicans pulled our country out of the 1970's Democratic malaise by electing Ronald Reagan. And I believe we can do it again by putting classic conservative values at the heart of everything we do. But there is no way I can pull it off without you. I've lived and worked in California for over 50 years, and I can tell you -\- voters here have had it with the Democrats like I've never seen before. They are hungry for change, and if you and I work together to reach voters in every neighborhood, on every beach, in every corner of California... I know we can turn this historic opportunity into a Republican win. I'm fighting for the soul of the state I love -- but make no mistake -- I'm not just taking the field for Californians. When we win here... when we rip this seat out the hands of the radical Adam Schiff... ...we start the nationwide Republican Comeback Rally our country desperately needs. | | It would be fair to wonder why someone would want to be in Congress. **For me, it is simple: we have made great progress but there is still more work to be done for you.** Representing Washington's second district is one of the greatest privileges of my life. Together, we have made remarkable progress for our community — from 1 million Washingtonians being insured under the Affordable Care Act, to bringing millions of dollars to the state to rebuild and advance our infrastructure. Our work is paying off. **I filed to run for re-election this week because there is more we can accomplish for Northwest Washington.** Some of my top priorities for next term include:
* **Protecting reproductive freedom:** abortion rights are under attack with attempts to ban medications, close clinics, and even criminalize patients who have sought care out of state.
* **Lowering prescription drug prices and ensuring access to health care:** I believe health care is a right and I support universal coverage, but even with good insurance the costs are high. For years drug companies have tried to block competitive pricing. We recently passed landmark legislation that allows Medicare to negotiate prescription drug prices, caps out-of-pocket drug costs for seniors, and caps insulin copays at $35 per month, all while cutting the deficit by $300 billion.
* **Supporting our veterans:** I worked to pass a bipartisan extension of a transportation program helping veterans travel to see their doctors, improving access to care for those living in remote communities. I am going to continue pushing legislation that will provide veterans with job skills training, give business owners a tax credit to hire veterans of the Iraq and Afghanistan wars, and help get more homeless veterans into permanent housing.
* **Improving affordability:** We must raise the federal minimum wage to $15 an hour by 2025. This simple step would give 32 million workers a raise and lift over a million people out of poverty. We need reinvestments in career and technical education and training so that our students and workers are trained for good, family-supporting careers like ones in aviation, manufacturing, and engineering.

Dear Friend,

You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.**

[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=ba135c96f8ca444291511511f51a4e5e&_e=LlRjgtvgUdVfQknLrV7im8ZUECx3RH3PWgdQHL0GmCuPVNjIoviV0ZRon1kikHHdOi359sPVtSJD4OW_lH0ieUaWq0EZscc1Go3VJ_d8IGWtcu_mXwaGnEkDoUZQwZBvcfyXqdVoWmgv4CHOAeYFw5FT8J0WSTImrOJaVr2EcgdG0K_n7hf8WmO_Kz2NydGnDQxsjhTI7tbNt7c5W4WP2EBM0dNkxH7vf9J2xT4mtF4Gixsb0dtprFsIW82hQUtiSpbBrLVK0J_QJinY5PMg_ukSrRopNkJShlRoDQa-El-AL4JW33fi2898X0WqG2XomnpefQh2sYvI_uBu2xRbe2nk6kC8YYfH9SLZV9KwM_pjkG-jHZkZ07Ity-e9nJkvEba3_k7vGyLXLdHsqwhLIh6L3NIBUqPo7o8NYJmvm2wpuZdp4-lENOx4ntsKhGNv)

The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...

Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.
Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.
The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in "extremist ideologies" and having the potential for "domestic terrorism."
Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty.

Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below:

[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=ba135c96f8ca444291511511f51a4e5e&_e=LlRjgtvgUdVfQknLrV7im8ZUECx3RH3PWgdQHL0GmCuPVNjIoviV0ZRon1kikHHdOi359sPVtSJD4OW_lH0ieUaWq0EZscc1Go3VJ_d8IGWtcu_mXwaGnEkDoUZQwZBvcfyXqdVoWmgv4CHOAeYFw5FT8J0WSTImrOJaVr2EcgdG0K_n7hf8WmO_Kz2NydGnDQxsjhTI7tbNt7c5W4WP2EBM0dNkxH7vf9J2xT4mtF4Gixsb0dtprFsIW82hQUtiSpbBrLVK0J_QJinY5PMg_gsEKu5FTPtse3pFU2iUtRnsEWwAzXZ26BWp4LrnJaBMKkOMCsW_jB6O7b8C2PbBrZrKDckaDw2PwxeZiFvtdriV2K-2exhuE-vl3vUvkdXL6feX-HJzi_TWbjQE_cBCKc_81Vb0R_INpJCZ8FlAmwS60gfnYklp0mLYkZ_8Mi8i)

Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."**

Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion."

These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties.

You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course.

**The first step is ...EDUCATION.**

Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities.

That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty.

We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.**

These efforts include:

**Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time.

Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

| MTG is NOT a serious person, which is why she was booed by members of her own party.

Neither is Speaker Johnson.

As I momentarily contemplated how I was going to vote on the motion, I reminded myself of [his views on the LGBTQ community](https://kamlagerforassembly.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7fbfb0a1bdf4e44789fab92d0&id=d289ac963f&e=e6ba7d1bc4), [a woman’s right to choose](https://kamlagerforassembly.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7fbfb0a1bdf4e44789fab92d0&id=837b174da7&e=e6ba7d1bc4), [a woman’s right to access fertility treatments](https://kamlagerforassembly.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7fbfb0a1bdf4e44789fab92d0&id=2261552c93&e=e6ba7d1bc4), and [his denial of the 2020 election results](https://kamlagerforassembly.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7fbfb0a1bdf4e44789fab92d0&id=3e810dbefe&e=e6ba7d1bc4). And then [what’s up with him hiding his son](https://kamlagerforassembly.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7fbfb0a1bdf4e44789fab92d0&id=3d5dd43feb&e=e6ba7d1bc4)??

I, and 31 other Democrats voted NO on the motion to table the MTV.

Johnson's speakership was saved today, just not by me. My vote was a value vote based on my work with Planned Parenthood and his work to degrade our freedoms.

We will be stuck with Speaker Johnson until the next MTV or November when Democrats win the Majority.
---
|
---
| Give Me Appliances or Give Me Death
On Tuesday, we voted on the "Hands off Our Home Appliances Act". I didn’t know my kitchen appliances were in danger. Have you heard from yours? It seems Republicans have, and they want to protect them. They don’t however, want to protect a woman’s right to choose, the sanctity of the vote, education, the constitution or democracy.

Each week, they plan to bring up more bills on this existential issue. In the hopper are: the "Liberty in Laundry Act", the "Clothes Dryers Reliability Act", the "Refrigerator Freedom Act", the "Affordable Air Conditioning Act" and the "Stop Unaffordable Dishwasher Standards Act". They **won't** however, be bringing up bills to fund Homeland Security, efforts to combat antisemitism, education, child care and the list goes on and on.

If you want to pause now, rub your head or get a drink... I say yes...

---
|
---
| Democracy on the Ropes
Yesterday, I attended a Foreign Affairs Committee hearing entitled, "Brazil: A Crisis of Democracy, Freedom and Rule of Law?" The hearing was important given that I sit on the committee and am co-chair of the Brazil Caucus.

It turned out to be a partisan sham.

Strengthening democracy _should_ be a top priority of the U.S. - Brazil relationship, given our countries’ shared experience with horrific attacks on our democratic institutions that were stoked by defeated thin-skinned former presidents seeking to reject the peaceful transition of power.

Instead, House Republicans used a hearing on protecting Brazil’s democracy as an attempt to _undermine_ it, by interfering in Brazil’s judicial process and giving a platform to the very individuals who spread lies about Brazil’s elections.

Seriously.

Republicans invited witnesses to testify BEFORE Congress, who are under investigation by the Brazilian Federal Police for their role in the January 8th coup attempt and who lied in their testimony about being under criminal investigation by Brazil's Federal Police and Attorney General.

These same Republicans were silent as the far-right Brazilian audience in attendance heckled and booed me, and even sided with a hostile witness I was interrogating.

Shameful.

Republicans have been trying to separate themselves from their albatross - Jan. 6th. They used the debate around Brazil’s fight against disinformation as an opportunity give themselves cover for their enabling of the January 6th insurrection.

I didn't let them get away with it (and now have new Brazilian trolls to prove it).

---
|
---
| Dirty Words
My grandmother would frown if I said a dirty word. She did not approve of foul language. Of course, I was always respectful in front of her, but succumbed to certain "french" words when out of earshot. Yesterday, I learned a new dirty word.

After battling with the committee Chair in the Brazil hearing, I went to my second Foreign Affairs committee hearing on the reauthorization of the U.S. International Development Financial Corporation (DFC). This is a VERY important department. The DFC helps to secure financing support for projects of all sizes in countries of great need. The goal is to help countries stabilize economically in order to positively impact health outcomes, poverty alleviation, migration and political calm.

The Director of the DFC talked about the need to bring more equity to the formulas they use to determine which countries they can help. Some countries are on the list because they are stone cold poor. Other countries are not on the list because they have access to natural resources that would qualify them as “rich”, even though they are unable to independently access those resources and still grapple with poverty. So, bringing equity into this discussion makes sense.

Or so I thought.

Don’t you know that a Republican colleague admonished the Director for using the word equity. He said, “equity is a dirty word.”

The literal definition of equity is: to be fair and impartial; the value of stocks in a company.

When did fairness and money become bad words? Is this the Twilight Zone?

---
|
---
| This email was a long one tonight, but you need to know the absurdity coming from Republicans.

They are trying every angle, and at every turn, to revise history, disrupt democracy, and gaslight the American people.

They are trying to sell the same toxic Kool-Aid that they are drinking.

I'm not having it. And you shouldn't either.

Our goal from now until November is to make sure that we put the lid on this toxicity. Our freedoms - and not the freedoms of our dishwashers - depend on it!

I hope you share this email with three friends who need some political motivation. I also hope you will consider contributing to my campaign. All you have to do is hit the button below.

name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: Getting the word out to empower and protect Texans / Estamos haciendo correr la voz para empoderar y proteger a los Tejanos
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
EmPOWERing Harris County
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Debra%20Walker%20Power%20Up.jpg]
TOP showed up and showed out for a press conference outside of Harris County Commissioners Court with Power Up Harris County coalition [https://powerinnumbers.us/campaigns/powerupharriscounty/] allies to urge local elected officials to take action to protect Houstonians from ever-increasing energy bills and the constant threat of grid failures at the hands of ERCOT.
Last month, the Biden-Harris Administration announced Harris County, along with a coalition of partners across Texas would receive a $250 million “Solar for All” grant . The grant will work to strengthen Harris County’s energy grid and make bills more affordable for low income and disadvantaged residents.
ERCOT and our state leaders have shown us they can’t be trusted, so now it’s on our local leaders to step up for everyday Harris County residents, so that we can continue to provide for our families and move our communities forward.
To learn more about TOP’s involvement in this coalition, contact Tiffany Hogue at thogue@organizetexas.org [thogue@organizetexas.org] .
#NoSB4, now and forever
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20TOP%20SB4.jpg]
Join us in calling on San Antonio Police Chief Bill McManus to NOT enforce SB4 and prioitize keeping ALL San Antonio communities safe.
SB4 [https://slate.com/news-and-politics/2024/04/sb4-texas-immigration-law-worse-than-you-think.html] is our state's latest racist, unconstitutional law that would let local law enforcement, like SAPD, stop and detain people suspected of being undocumented. It enables racial profiling as it unfairly targets communities of color, and threatens the wellbeing of many Texans who lived in mixed status households.
SB4 will also lead to an increase in incarcerations which will only waste taxpayer dollars to prosecute, and jail people instead of focusing on keeping our community safe. Other metro area police departments have already come out against this bill, such as Fort Worth and Austin. They maintain that their police shall follow the law but firmly believe that immigration enforcement lies within the hands of federal institutions NOT local law enforcement.
SIGN OUR petition calling on SAPD to NOT enforce SB4 at any cost. [https://secure.everyaction.com/83kSSjU0yUue3NE8yXTP8g2]
For more information, contact Jax Garcia at jaxgarcia@organizetexas.org [jaxgarcia@organizetexas.org] .
Help us elect a progressive community leader to the Texas House
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Day%20of%20action%20Lauren%20Ashley%20Simmons.jpg]
We need to make sure we have real people-powered champions in office, representing our values and putting in the work to implement progressive policy. Lauren Ashley Simmons [https://www.laurenashleysimmons.com/] is OUR choice for HD146, and we need to ensure she is our candidate for this upcoming primary runoff election on May 28th.
This past election, you all showed up and Lauren received more votes than Shawn Thierry, but not the majority, so the work is not over!
On May 18th at 10 a.m. , TOP, along with AFL-CIO, Houston Federation of Teachers (HFT), LGBTQ+ Political Caucus, LGBTQ+ Victory Fund, Community Voices for Public Education, Texas Working Families Party, Indivisible Houston, and Communication Workers of America (CWA).
We will be starting at the Texas State Employees Union HQ (9247 South Main Street).
TOP Tips: Help bail out Black mamas this Mother's Day
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/National%20Bail%20Out%20logo.png]
What if jails across the country were a little less crowded this Mother’s Day? Well this Mother’s Day National Bail Out is working to make this happen! Learn more about their critical work here and pitch in to the cause! [https://www.nationalbailout.org/]
Español
Empoderando al condado de Harris
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Debra%20Walker%20Power%20Up.jpg]
TOP se presentó y se presentó en una conferencia de prensa afuera del Tribunal de Comisionados del Condado de Harris con los aliados de l a coalición Power Up del Condado de Harris [http://powerinnumbers.us/campaigns/powerupharriscounty/] para instar a los funcionarios electos locales a tomar medidas para proteger a los habitantes de Houston de las facturas de energía cada vez mayores y la amenaza constante de fallas en la red. de ERCOT.
El mes pasado, la Administración Biden-Harris anunció que el condado de Harris, junto con una coalición de socios en todo Texas, recibiría una subvención de 250 millones de dólares para “Solar para todos.” La subvención trabajará para fortalecer la red energética del condado de Harris y hacer que las facturas sean más asequibles para los residentes de bajos ingresos y desfavorecidos.
ERCOT y nuestros líderes estatales nos han demostrado que no se puede confiar en ellos, por lo que ahora corresponde a nuestros líderes locales dar un paso al frente por los residentes cotidianos del condado de Harris, para que podamos continuar brindando apoyo a nuestras familias y haciendo avanzar a nuestras comunidades.
Para obtener más información sobre la participación de TOP en esta coalición, comuníquese con Tiffany Hogue en thogue@organizetexas.org [thogue@organizetexas.org] .
#NoSB4, ahora y siempre
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20TOP%20SB4.jpg]
Únase a nosotros para pedirle al jefe de policía de San Antonio, Bill McManus, que NO haga cumplir la SB4 y dé prioridad a mantener seguras a TODAS las comunidades de San Antonio.
La SB4 [https://slate.com/news-and-politics/2024/04/sb4-texas-immigration-law-worse-than-you-think.html] es la última ley racista e inconstitucional de nuestro estado que permitiría a las autoridades locales, como el SAPD, detener y detener a personas sospechosas de ser indocumentadas. Permite la elaboración de perfiles raciales, ya que apunta injustamente a las comunidades de color y amenaza el bienestar de muchos tejanos que vivían en hogares de estatus mixto.
La SB4 también conducirá a un aumento en los encarcelamientos, lo que solo desperdiciará el dinero de los contribuyentes para procesar y encarcelar a personas en lugar de centrarse en mantener segura a nuestra comunidad.
Otros departamentos de policía del área metropolitana ya se han manifestado en contra de este proyecto de ley, como Fort Worth y Austin. Sostienen que su policía debe cumplir la ley, pero creen firmemente que la aplicación de la ley en materia de inmigración está en manos de las instituciones federales, NO de las autoridades locales.
FIRME NUESTRA petición pidiendo al SAPD que NO haga cumplir la SB4 a cualquier costo. [https://secure.everyaction.com/83kSSjU0yUue3NE8yXTP8g2]
Para obtener más información, comuníquese con Jax García en jaxgarcia@organizetexas.org [jaxgarcia@organizetexas.org] .
Ayúdenos a elegir un líder comunitario progresista para la Cámara de Representantes de Texas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Day%20of%20action%20Lauren%20Ashley%20Simmons.jpg]
Necesitamos asegurarnos de tener en el poder a verdaderos defensores impulsados por las personas, que representen nuestros valores y se esfuercen por implementar políticas progresistas. Lauren Ashley Simmons [https://www.laurenashleysimmons.com/] es NUESTRA elección para HD146 y debemos asegurarnos de que sea nuestra candidata para las próximas elecciones el 28 de mayo.
En las pasadas elecciones, todos ustedes se presentaron y Lauren recibió más votos que Shawn Thierry pero no la mayoría, ¡así que el trabajo no ha terminado!
El 18 de mayo a las 10 a.m. , TOP, junto con AFL-CIO, la Federación de Maestros de Houston (HFT), el Caucus Político LGBTQ+, el Fondo de Victoria LGBTQ+, Community Voices for Public Education, el Partido de las Familias Trabajadoras de Texas, Indivisible Houston y Communication Workers of America ( CWA).
Comenzaremos en la sede del Sindicato de Empleados del Estado de Texas (9247 South Main St.).
Consejos de TOP: Ayude a rescatar a las mamás negras este Día de la Madre
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/National%20Bail%20Out%20logo.png]
¿Qué pasaría si las cárceles de todo el país estuvieran un poco menos abarrotadas este Día de la Madre? ¡Bueno, este Día de la Madre, National Bail Out está trabajando para que esto suceda! ¡Obtenga más información sobre su trabajo crítico aquí y contribuya a la causa! [https://www.nationalbailout.org/]

[] Español Empoderando al condado de Harris [] TOP se presentó y se presentó en una conferencia de prensa afuera del Tribunal de Comisionados del Condado de Harris con los aliados de l a coalición Power Up del Condado de Harris [] para instar a los funcionarios electos locales a tomar medidas para proteger a los habitantes de Houston de las facturas de energía cada vez mayores y la amenaza constante de fallas en la red. de ERCOT. El mes pasado, la Administración Biden-Harris anunció que el condado de Harris, junto con una coalición de socios en todo Texas, recibiría una subvención de 250 millones de dólares para “Solar para todos.” La subvención trabajará para fortalecer la red energética del condado de Harris y hacer que las facturas sean más asequibles para los residentes de bajos ingresos y desfavorecidos. ERCOT y nuestros líderes estatales nos han demostrado que no se puede confiar en ellos, por lo que ahora corresponde a nuestros líderes locales dar un paso al frente por los residentes cotidianos del condado de Harris, para que podamos continuar brindando apoyo a nuestras familias y haciendo avanzar a nuestras comunidades. Para obtener más información sobre la participación de TOP en esta coalición, comuníquese con Tiffany Hogue en thogue@organizetexas.org [thogue@organizetexas.org] . #NoSB4, ahora y siempre [] Únase a nosotros para pedirle al jefe de policía de San Antonio, Bill McManus, que NO haga cumplir la SB4 y dé prioridad a mantener seguras a TODAS las comunidades de San Antonio. La SB4 [] es la última ley racista e inconstitucional de nuestro estado que permitiría a las autoridades locales, como el SAPD, detener y detener a personas sospechosas de ser indocumentadas. Permite la elaboración de perfiles raciales, ya que apunta injustamente a las comunidades de color y amenaza el bienestar de muchos tejanos que vivían en hogares de estatus mixto. La SB4 también conducirá a un aumento en los encarcelamientos, lo que solo desperdiciará el dinero de los contribuyentes para procesar y encarcelar a personas en lugar de centrarse en mantener segura a nuestra comunidad. Otros departamentos de policía del área metropolitana ya se han manifestado en contra de este proyecto de ley, como Fort Worth y Austin. Sostienen que su policía debe cumplir la ley, pero creen firmemente que la aplicación de la ley en materia de inmigración está en manos de las instituciones federales, NO de las autoridades locales. FIRME NUESTRA petición pidiendo al SAPD que NO haga cumplir la SB4 a cualquier costo. [] Para obtener más información, comuníquese con Jax García en jaxgarcia@organizetexas.org [jaxgarcia@organizetexas.org] . Ayúdenos a elegir un líder comunitario progresista para la Cámara de Representantes de Texas [] Necesitamos asegurarnos de tener en el poder a verdaderos defensores impulsados por las personas, que representen nuestros valores y se esfuercen por implementar políticas progresistas. Lauren Ashley Simmons [] es NUESTRA elección para HD146 y debemos asegurarnos de que sea nuestra candidata para las próximas elecciones el 28 de mayo. En las pasadas elecciones, todos ustedes se presentaron y Lauren recibió más votos que Shawn Thierry pero no la mayoría, ¡así que el trabajo no ha terminado! El 18 de mayo a las 10 a.m. , TOP, junto con AFL-CIO, la Federación de Maestros de Houston (HFT), el Caucus Político LGBTQ+, el Fondo de Victoria LGBTQ+, Community Voices for Public Education, el Partido de las Familias Trabajadoras de Texas, Indivisible Houston y Communication Workers of America ( CWA). Comenzaremos en la sede del Sindicato de Empleados del Estado de Texas (9247 South Main St.). body:

| | | This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zj1t2fdldifegsd5mh17kqlflprrslc0915aqdbo_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c9gm9o36c5h2bs)

The history of the Roman Republic is a captivating tale of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success. One that still impacts our world today.

To help tell this important story to Americans nationwide, we released our free online course, **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic."**

**You can now receive your own DVD box set of "The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic" when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**

And, for a limited time, we'll also send you a **free color map** of the Roman world at the end of the Republic. This map is a helpful companion to the course DVD and will illustrate many of the topics discussed in the lectures. Simply use this secure link to reserve your DVD box set of **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic," **along with the companion map today:

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/roman-republic-dvd**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zuvq7m2md56maf8f198mcl1a8utft8t3gc8bb7cg_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c9gm9o36c5h2bs)

By studying ancient Rome, you'll discover the conditions necessary to preserve a republic . . . and how a republic may lose its way.

That's why we produced **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic"** and why I hope you'll watch and share the course on DVD.

Thank you for helping to preserve liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!

Best regards,

Hillsdale College

subject: How often do you think about the Roman Republic?
body:
"The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic."

| | | This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z9o25gl4tcofrqfvfn5o05o2aq2pn17sa6cqvclo_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c9im4ob4clh2bs)

| |
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zhjsgkj044h0h9a74asko6c29780binj69ivvp0o_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c9im4ob4clh2bs) Dear Friend,

The history of the Roman Republic is a captivating tale of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success. One that still impacts our world today.

To help tell this important story to Americans nationwide, we released our free online course, **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic."**

**You can now receive your own DVD box set of "The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic" when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**

And, for a limited time, we'll also send you a **free color map** of the Roman world at the end of the Republic. This map is a helpful companion to the course DVD and will illustrate many of the topics discussed in the lectures. Simply use this secure link to reserve your DVD box set of **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic," **along with the companion map today:

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/roman-republic-dvd**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zpjroakqva5act9qd57clabevmd7vfkki85ml6m8_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c9im4ob4clh2bs)

By studying ancient Rome, you'll discover the conditions necessary to preserve a republic . . . and how a republic may lose its way.

That's why we produced **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic"** and why I hope you'll watch and share the course on DVD.

Thank you for helping to preserve liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

subject: How often do you think about the Roman Republic?
body:
"The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic."

| | | This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z24l1v1oriupv6a4e1750rno4gr29prcllb5483o_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c9im2oj2c5h2bs)

| |
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zeemtppntfgab7k7rv5jashqfnfoi0eiiuun2eh0_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c9im2oj2c5h2bs) Dear Friend,

The history of the Roman Republic is a captivating tale of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success. One that still impacts our world today.

To help tell this important story to Americans nationwide, we released our free online course, **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic."**

**You can now receive your own DVD box set of "The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic" when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**

And, for a limited time, we'll also send you a **free color map** of the Roman world at the end of the Republic. This map is a helpful companion to the course DVD and will illustrate many of the topics discussed in the lectures. Simply use this secure link to reserve your DVD box set of **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic," **along with the companion map today:

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/roman-republic-dvd**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z808cc3hhq36ahhcsc58muoj5s1abepa4ltc0s48_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c9im2oj2c5h2bs)

By studying ancient Rome, you'll discover the conditions necessary to preserve a republic . . . and how a republic may lose its way.

That's why we produced **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic"** and why I hope you'll watch and share the course on DVD.

Thank you for helping to preserve liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

body:
No images? [Click here](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-e-edljuhl-tlidtddjku-z/) Team Carris,The conflict in Israel continues to affect our nation and our own District with over 12% of the 10th Congressional District's population made up of Jewish families who continue to watch rampant antisemitism on the rise in Illinois and the U.S. We see it in the images coming from college campuses that are now ground zero for protests that unfortunately have many individuals pushing hate, antisemitic and racist rhetoric. Pro-Palestinian protests and encampments continue to disrupt classes, final exams and spring commencement ceremonies. Students and faculty worry about their physical safety in their dormitories, on-campus housing, and walking around campus. In the nearly three weeks since the first arrests were made at Columbia University on April 18, encampments have been created throughout a multitude of states. In fact, the encampment at George Washington University was finally taken down by law enforcement, 13 days after it was initially set up. According to CNN, "By the end of the day on Friday, May 3, there were more than 2,100 arrests on more than 40 campuses across 25 states." _*Image Taken From CNN, May 8, 2024_ There is no circumstance where antisemitism should be accepted - even under the guise of peaceful protests. Where is our nation's leadership to put an end to this? This issue will continue to escalate in a void of leadership from the Biden Administration and Congress. As Majority Whip Tom Emmer said recently, "Joe Biden's first, formal address on the pro-terrorist, antisemitic college protests lasted a whopping three minutes and did not include any solutions to actually address the problem." It's time for the politicians in Washington to step up and take action. It's time to stand on the right side of history and enforce accountability. Jim Carris
Candidate for Congress Mental Health Awareness Month May is Mental Health Awareness Month! This Month was established in 1949 by Mental Health America (MHA) to increase awareness of the importance of mental health and wellness in Americans' lives, and to celebrate recovery from mental illness.According to MHA, "One in 5 people will experience a mental health condition in any given year, and everyone faces challenges in life that can impact their mental health. About half of Americans will meet the criteria for a diagnosable mental health condition sometime in their lives, with symptoms starting by age 14 for the majority of people."It's more important now than ever to continue to discuss mental health in our community to defeat the stigma and increase access to resources. Visit [https://www.mhanational.org/mental-health-month](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-edljuhl-tlidtddjku-r/) to learn more about resources and what you can do to learn more and help others. You can also learn more about resources for Illinois' 10th Congressional District here:
* [NAMI Lake County Chapter](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-edljuhl-tlidtddjku-y/)
* [Lake County Community Resources](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-edljuhl-tlidtddjku-j/)
* [Lake County Health Department Behavioral Health Services](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-edljuhl-tlidtddjku-t/)
* [McHenry County Mental Health Resource Guide](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-edljuhl-tlidtddjku-i/)
* [NAMI Cook County North Suburban Chapter](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-edljuhl-tlidtddjku-d/)

[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-edljuhl-tlidtddjku-h/) Border Chaos: Our Communities Are in Crisis I believe that part of the role as a Congressman is learning about the challenges that a district is facing and so I made the decision recently to go directly to the epicenter of our country's immigration issue, the southern border. I shared an OpEd with the Patch this week about my recent trip to Yuma, Arizona. It's clear that southern border crisis is no longer only affecting the states that border Mexico - every state has become a border state. visit the physical border, meet with local law enforcement, visit with healthcare professionals, and sit with NGO leaders who are all on the front lines, are all overwhelmed, and are only surviving because their community is shouldering the costs.**What I witnessed and learned was heartbreaking and shocking. **I've included an excerpt below and make sure to click the button to read the entire submission. _" In Chicago and our local communities, we're feeling the effects of a federal government that is refusing to take action and thus wrongly passing its responsibilities onto local and state governments who are unprepared and lack resources and guidance. The lack of action by the Biden Administration has forced local authorities throughout the country to bear the brunt of this crisis - diverting and straining already precious resources to hastily create a safety net for migrants, all while bypassing the needs of their residents. __Communities along the border and beyond are grappling with the overwhelming influx of migrants, stretching essential services like healthcare, education, and law enforcement to their limits. Schools are faced with accommodating an influx of new students, often with limited English proficiency and unique educational needs. Healthcare facilities and crisis centers are inundated with patients, exacerbating existing resource shortages and increasing wait times for essential medical services. Law enforcement agencies are tasked with maintaining public safety amidst rising crime rates and illicit activities associated with illegal immigration.__**Border patrol estimates that**_ _**over 11 million people have come over the border under the Biden Administration**_ _. Of those 11 million people, 25% are "gottaways" which are people who were not processed through ICE - meaning their country of origin, their intent within the U.S., and their location is unknown. **That 's over **__**2.5 million people that the government knows absolutely nothing about**_ _**which poses a real national security and public safety risk. "**_ [Read My Immigration OpEd Here](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-edljuhl-tlidtddjku-k/) **On the Road in #IL10** 🇺🇸 **Diving Into One of IL10 's Most Precious Resources: Water**
I toured the Central Lake County Joint Action Water Agency and met with Executive Director Bill Soucie to learn more about the facility and its services. CLCJAWA delivers drinking water to 19 communities situated in Central Lake County. Ultimately, these communities distribute water to approximately 285,000 residents. Did you know that in 2005, the Agency received the Phase IV Excellence in Water Treatment certification from the Partnership for Safe Water, identifying its staff and facilities as meeting the highest standards for quality in the production and distribution of drinking water? CLCJAWA is the third organization to be granted this prestigious recognition and the first conventional water treatment plant in the United States to achieve this distinction. 🇺🇸 **Conversing with Our Nation 's Future Leaders in Winnetka**
One of my favorite parts of the campaign trail is talking to young people in the District. I was excited to visit North Shore Country Day School in Winnetka to speak to AP US Government & Politics students about my platform and answer their questions as part of their election project that focused on Illinois' 10th Congressional District. I was incredibly impressed with how thoughtful their questions were, ranging from how to help small business owners succeed, to immigration, to support for law enforcement. As part of their project, they simulated a debate and I was honored to meet the student who played me! After meeting these young people, our future is in good hands. 🇺🇸 **Celebrating Leadership in the Republican Party**
My wife Kimberly and I had the honor of attending the Lake County Republican Federation 62nd Annual Spring Gala with Keynote Speaker Representative Darin LaHood. The evening was filled with energy, excitement, and support for candidates like 9th Congressional District's Seth Alan as we gear up for the November 5 general elections. Thank you to the Executive Committee and Larry Falbe for inviting me to share some remarks about why I'm running for office and the issues that are affecting our District. Alongside other incredible leaders like Senator Mark Kirk, it was an inspiring event! 🇺🇸 **Supporting Our Local Small Businesses During #SmallBusinessWeek**
May is Small Business Appreciation Month! I recently visited a gem of a small business in our district, Momcorn, owned by Edgar Rojas. Momcorn opened in 2012 as a fresh and modern take on a Mexican taqueria and specializes in Mexican food made with quality ingredients from scratch. The name "Momcorn" embraces the role of corn as a staple - or "mother grain" \- in the diet of the original inhabitants of Mexico. Customers from all over IL-10 love Edgar's delicious, natural, and healthy food at a reasonable price. He also has gluten free and vegan options available! One small way to celebrate our small businesses this month is to spread the word and try out their offerings. Are you interested in hosting a meet and greet for Team Carris or inviting Jim to your event? Email us at info@carrisforcongress.com! **Join Team Carris** **Upcoming Volunteer Event! March with Team Carris at the Grayslake Memorial Day Parade** Join us on Memorial Day at the 2024 Village of Grayslake Memorial Day Parade. The VFW and TAL start the Parade at Grayslake Community High School and conclude the parade at Grayslake's Memorial Park, which is at the junction of Seymour and Junior Ave in the historical homes area of downtown Grayslake. **Event Information**
**Date: **Monday, May 27, 2024
**Time: **
* 8:30am - Line Up in the Hillside Parking Lot (Hillside Ave. and Lake St. near Grayslake Central High School)
* 9:30am - Parade Step Off

**Parking and Step Off Location: **Grayslake Central High School, 400 N. Lake Street, Grayslake**Parade Route: **The parade travels south on Lake St., then east on Junior Ave, ending at Seymour Ave. and Park Pl. **Volunteer with Us**
We need your help! Join our team to make a difference by attending events, connecting with neighbors and constituents around the District, and sharing information with your network. [Click Here to Sign Up to Volunteer](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-edljuhl-tlidtddjku-n/) **Request a Yard Sign**
Spread the word about Team Carris in your neighborhood! If you would like one of our team members to drop of a sign(s), please fill out the form below by clicking the button! [Click Here to Request a Sign](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-edljuhl-tlidtddjku-p/) **Check Out Our Summer Internship Opportunities**
Calling all students and recent grads! Are you looking to join a dynamic team of volunteers this summer to work on a congressional campaign? Apply today to join Team Carris for a summer internship. As a Team Carris Intern, you will get experience working on a congressional campaign and learn the inner-workings of the campaign world. The program is open to high school students, college students, and recent graduates - no prior campaign experience is required. [Click Here to Apply](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-edljuhl-tlidtddjku-x/) **Follow Carris for Congress on Social Media** **Post of the Week:** Head over to my social media channels to learn more about my thoughts on the ongoing college campus protests. Do you want to stay in touch and follow Jim throughout the 10th District? Make sure to follow us on social media to learn about Jim's platform and to get to know the District through his experience meeting local residents, supporting small businesses and local organizations, and learning about how #IL10 families really want their representative to vote in Washington. **Click Below to Follow** [](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-edljuhl-tlidtddjku-m/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-edljuhl-tlidtddjku-c/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-edljuhl-tlidtddjku-q/)
**Share with Your Friends!**
We also need your help! You can download the Social Media Toolkit below to share your support with your network on your favorite social media channels. Create a post today and don't forget to tag us and use #carrisforcongress. We will share our favorite posts! [Click Here to Download](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-edljuhl-tlidtddjku-a/) **Support Carris for Congress** Jim is on a mission to bring independence, compassion, and common sense to Washington. Your continued financial support will help us reach more voters through our grassroots organizing efforts. Together, we can secure a win for Illinois and for our country by sending Jim to our nation's capital! [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/0PoyM4WumKFRc1ShLLPd2Q~~/AARclAA~) Dear Friend,

The history of the Roman Republic is a captivating tale of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success. One that still impacts our world today.

To help tell this important story to Americans nationwide, we released our free online course, **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic."**

**You can now receive your own DVD box set of "The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic" when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**

And, for a limited time, we'll also send you a **free color map** of the Roman world at the end of the Republic. This map is a helpful companion to the course DVD and will illustrate many of the topics discussed in the lectures. Simply use this secure link to reserve your DVD box set of **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic," **along with the companion map today:

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/roman-republic-dvd**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/0PoyM4WumKFRc1ShLLPd2Q~~/AARclAA~)

By studying ancient Rome, you'll discover the conditions necessary to preserve a republic . . . and how a republic may lose its way.

That's why we produced **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic"** and why I hope you'll watch and share the course on DVD.

Thank you for helping to preserve liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

King Charles II was so impressed with Blood's audacity, that he made Blood a court member with an annual pension. I have to put gas in it, and the cup holders were extra_." His wife thinks _Flyover_ readers will agree with her. Let us know what you think in the poll below! ## Greene Fails to Oust Johnson
The House moved quickly Wednesday to [strike down a motion](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFugzAQQL8GNiPnsAkMDF3Y0rUjMvYZLjE-ZDtB-fsqnbs96S1P7-c23wwFiuu32XEsnmdjC71w1mIQoGZVu9EjArY1jpfrRYPuJbT1NoLrOr14Bb5FC4t2crDemfaqe7C9h5pGkKCkloPsddfqxkunnNawKNMN0g2VkuiocGruTLFs6MObX5gay3sdxq2UI1ftVwVTBdN5nk1cbMQzf3wF08GBCtlcwWQ5rgnzBxMeYjfpzolQFPMOnMSaECMKz8lSXMWLCwp-5iLygeaBSdx5i5mjeD6SoYjCiGSjuai-7Yc6je44KQTK3bVSct0Nhb_E8t-v3wAAAP__DP5vbg) by Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene to oust Speaker Mike Johnson in a lopsided 359-43 vote. Greene has made numerous statements and threats, dating back to March, [about forcing a vote](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAQQL_G3oiOAxwzMHTJlq4drbM5YlIMFqaJ8vdVOnd8esvT-7pOV4op5tsnbexaKBMtLT54MsIK1JPuvQvMyKpnJ8_SoBkBVb86HsGPXttFkjVWSR-CkhZH0MCwoOqjQ0ANBiyMZlDmFMBrbwzOmgYL3nYa2MdW6uleYm4rh_QqD66npWx9cmtr-9Gpjw4vHV5oz_w83uoNtcUlcYeXY2f65iruZc1HyaL8HE1spcWSRSviQQs1FhvVe6mRRaNXKlXcKnNmoUf0JKUKRuM8IDPAbIIcLAYzkpn76vz-jCnFYzh3Gm4bxfRX1_5b9RsAAP__XnJqKQ) if Johnson advanced a foreign aid package with funds for Ukraine. The measure was overwhelmingly approved last month. Standing before House members on Wednesday, Greene read a list of transgressions she believed Johnson had committed as Speaker. Some of her colleagues were heard booing her as she called for a vote. [See Greene call for a vote here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1uwyAUQOGnwRsRXH4cDwxdvKVrR4uGSyABE8Ftorx9lc6dv-FI5-u0nXwueb98-oqOYtv8mfIDN8MXDnrTU3AREVBN6OQsDZijADUlp6UEaRBVFBKjXYRVVkUVYQ5xDnaesgMBWhixiKOxyhyiCDoYA9_a20WEhWmBIVPrh2vLOyWM5dUe2A_nVqfiEtF9MPXBYGWwUsKUS3kbgzW1ijs-B4NVWwNaHvnT0zlxSsjrG4lX36-tZ-TkX6V1fumI-1sfODg13n4G8XFHf8POa74hv7a0j7YzWKfuwv2ZS8nDzkyLS_X5rz3Rf5N-AwAA___deWnG). [196 Republicans and 163 Democrats](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFugzAQQL8GNiPnsAkMDF3Y0rUjMvYZLjE-ZDtB-fsqnbs96S1P7-c23wwFiuu32XEsnmdjC71w1mIQoGZVu9EjArY1jpfrRYPuJbT1NoLrOr14Bb5FC4t2crDemfaqe7C9h5pGkKCkloPsddfqxkunnNawKNMN0g2VkuiocGruTLFs6MObX5gay3sdxq2UI1ftVwVTBdN5nk1cbMQzf3wF08GBCtlcwWQ5rgnzBxMeYjfpzolQFPMOnMSaECMKz8lSXMWLCwp-5iLygeaBSdx5i5mjeD6SoYjCiGSjuai-7Yc6je44KQTK3bVSct0Nhb_E8t-v3wAAAP__DP5vbg) voted to kill Greene's motion; 11 Republicans and 32 Democrats voted to move forward with the motion.
## Biden Pivots on Immigration
The Biden administration will propose [new immigration rules](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOwyAQBb_G7ogIC9gUFNeky7VXWsAuyUbYRJhLlL8_JfV172ma0fycl3PgwtvlO6zke65LSJ0ftBjhhNKLHtFnIkUwkj9OR6PMLBWMV-8gOZsCYCZIM8V5QjQxgHQUkwY7sldSaWmkk7OxYA5ZokZjVNTBOolu0JKQe22HW-WtXymXV31QO6S6jsVfe7_vA3wN6jSoU7hv9Nzf6H1a51RoUKdbJREZaROxNqQmeF350kLnuonP2vouwv4qv6sAG2erMhBlgJkQHU0hHsMEmJ1OZmwe708uhXc7DVpe1sDlY9P_S_MXAAD__8TeZfg) today, affecting migrants with criminal records or those ineligible for asylum in the U.S. Under the proposed changes, migrants crossing the border illegally and requesting asylum would be subjected to interviews. Those who fail the interview would face [immediate deportation](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj72OwyAQhJ8GOiyygGMXFNe4y7VXWsQszp74iQwJytufkvq60cxIn76fy3pxFCnv3y6hbaGsbmv0xNWIWYBeNfc2IAIqjvZ0PhkwkwTFbxYgjKPWIDftTwFdwKDcBpO_TlKdQXOyIEFLI2c5mVGZIUivvTFw1W6cpZ-ZluiplWP4LZTbDUN8lScew1YSj_bW2r0y9cVgYbD03oftWjP2-t4ZLO_IYKGUaD9co5LFowpXX_GRxKfLrYqMXRy4P-LnwWDhh_X3TjFSHc9Myz05ih9k-8__LwAA__9DbV3k). New rules would also allow officials to reject and deport migrants who pose a danger to public safety or national security soon after they cross the border. U.S. law already bars migrants in those categories from entering the country. President Biden's [abrupt pivot ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFvgzAQBeBfY2-OjsM2ePDQhS1dOyLDHcGVwZFxkvbfV2Tu9qQ3PH3v6zpeQ0xxv32GjX1d8hjmGp88GuUU6lFL8gszcivZN11j0PSArVw9cd8jdmgsOx0CzWT01NnetQgA4GT0CKjBgIPe2NZcFiBNxuCkg3VATmhgijWXy3eOe115Sb_5yeUy500mv9Z6P0T7IXAQONSV15jS2Qkc1rzxzq_jHR8HCxy0NU1rG0W85bmEeqgpEu-Kf3h-nCR1yvKuplyIi8BBFk_3V0wpHrYTGm5biO8BWf974i8AAP__xGle7w)to border security and immigration policy follows a letter sent to the White House Tuesday by 15 House Democrats calling on him to act. Many of the Democrats who signed the letter are facing tough reelection contests.
## Air Force Airlifts Cruise Ship Passengers
A U.S. Air Force rescue team airlifted two cruise ship passengers 400 miles off the Atlantic coast over the weekend, and [photos](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuhSAUANCvwQ2DV0AZHJombq_p1I4G5aK3RXwBnub167t07Bec5HzeppulQHF9szsOxR-TXQqdOCluOMhJVm7wiIBthUPTNQpUL6CttkE7QPRatx36RXfN3GsDsjMGOq1nP1c0gAAplDCiV7pVtRdOOqVgllYb4QyTAh2VI9VfB8WyoQ_P48RUL8dehWEr5Z5Z-8JgZDBe11U7S-G5Wwr1ctSPbwZjxCszGG0qtATkTdsa1ZuGwfhuc8a4YuKWUiBf0PFXmyKdNvAPjPhDli_pQRl5II8825PiyhPm5YH1VvZQpcHdLwqBsu6YFOsfvVflv6nfAAAA__8e3GuU) have now emerged of the event. The Carnival cruise ship _Venezia_ was returning from a tour of the Caribbean when one of its passengers had a medical emergency. The [Air Force dispatched](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1u7CAQRp8Gd1h4-FlTUNzG3d42pUXMYE-CzQpYW3n7aJM29ffp6Oi83ee7p0TH-t_v6FrMs18anThrbjmoWXXBRURA2aEbboMGPQqQ3eZGI5cozSB9GIZorYUIQhorZAgqGNWRAwFKaGHFqI3UfRRBBa3hXXljRbBMCQzUcuk_Mh1tw5i-8omlX_LeJbe19qhM_mMwMZiu6-qX8qSKG534ujCYnpV7KjzmsiDf_SdWnvKx8uKPFV9Toth4LHnniy8HnT7xXwivGz0YTIOEmxm74sLjopSomhtTYt09pR-N9leT7wAAAP__I_ZjWw) two HH-60G _Pave Hawk_ helicopters, along with two airplanes needed to refuel the helicopters three times during the journey. A pararescue team descended to the _Venezia 's_ deck and returned to the chopper with a male passenger and his mother tow, and they treated the patient during the trip to a New York hospital. Carnival hasn't revealed the nature of the medical emergency.

name: Karen Crnkovich
subject: Less than 3 months away!
body:
The primary election in Kansas is less than 3 months away.

Deciding to run for Congress wasn’t a decision I made lightly. While I’ve held many leadership positions in the community over the years, I’ve never run for political office.

I decided to get in the race to represent Kansas’ third congressional district because I’m genuinely concerned about the state of our nation. And I am frustrated about how dysfunctional our government is. It shouldn’t be THIS hard for families and businesses to survive.

[Rather than talk about it, I decided to DO something about it. We have enough do NOTHING people in Congress.](https://secure.winred.com/karen-crnkovich-for-congress/donate)

As a small business owner, I have first-hand experience with the struggle to make payroll, navigating supply chain shortages, and managing manpower shortages.

As the owner of an HVAC and plumbing company, I’ve experienced how confusing, complicated, and downright frustrating government laws and regulations are.

As an employer in the skilled trades, I know how vital these jobs are to people’s lives and livelihoods... and how seriously the skilled workforce shortages are affecting our economy.

As a non-profit founder of an organization that provides home critical repairs for families in need, I understand the overwhelming burden of sky-high inflation and interest rates and see how it is affecting our community.

And, as a stepmom of a college student, I’ve seen the sacrifices students and their families make for a good education... and how unfair it seems that some people get handouts while others can barely get by.

In my business and my home, it’s my job to fix things and keep systems running. And I mean it when I say I will bring that same approach to serving you in Congress.

But I am not a politician, and I do not have the backing of the Washington Power Brokers. So I am relying on my friends, family, colleagues, neighbors, and industry partners to get there.

[Would you please donate $90 or whatever is meaningful to you to my campaign today?](https://secure.winred.com/karen-crnkovich-for-congress/donate)

I’m running a lean operation, so I can assure you that I will treat every dollar as if it were my own. I know how hard you work for your money and how many sacrifices you have to make to give to a campaign or a cause you believe in... I appreciate it more than I can say.

Thank you,

Karen

Karen Crnkovich for Congress, KS03 ____
[www.kcforkansas.com](http://www.kcforkansas.com/) ____
913-414-4446
#teamkc

Hey - my name is Byron Donalds.

As Co-Chair of one of the most important initiatives of the Republican Party, I wanted you to what we're doing right now to lay the groundwork for the biggest GOP landslide in AMERICAN HISTORY!

_**[A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen- so bear with me for a minute:](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z64kl3eqiaib60mq6dse8bt183c0e16g4q8g309g_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c9hm1or0sdh2bs "A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen – so bear with me for a minute:")**_

-> We're expanding GOTV efforts to get young Conservatives to the ballot box

These are the nuts and bolts of winning campaigns up and down the ballot. And I'm proud to help lead these efforts.

As Conservatives, we have the issues on our side. We are the only commonsense Party. **If we get these campaign operations right, the Democrats are in serious trouble come election day.**

_But I have to be honest with you: building this level of infrastructure is very expensive._ We're running ads in costly swing-state markets, printing campaign literature, filling up gas tanks to knock doors, recruiting volunteers, and scaling up our voter contact programs.

And unlike the Democrats, we don't rely on Liberal billionaires and rich celebrities for funding.

I'm perfectly okay with that. Nothing matters more this fall than ensuring a victory for democracy, reasonable sanity, and the middle class of Michigan and this country. That effort runs through this U.S. Senate race, and through the best state in the union, Michigan.
Here's what I am doing to make it happen:

**Traveling around the state meeting with voters** and building support for our campaign in "blue" areas and also so-called "red areas" -- the kind of work that will lift Democrats’ chances even in areas they don't historically do well.

This is a defining time -- one where future generations will look back and thank us for meeting the moment, or wonder what we were doing when it mattered most.

** Good Morning Republicans,
------------------------------------------------------------
Verse of the Newsletter: Isaiah 53:5 But he was pierced for our rebellion, crushed for our sins. He was beaten so we could be whole. He was whipped so we could be healed.
I wanted to resend some of the more important election themed newsletters as we've reached almost 30,000 email subscribers to our list. I wanted to resend some of the more important election themed newsletters. Tuesday, May 14th is our Nebraska Primary. In 93 counties, Republicans will have the opportunity to be difference makers. Federal races to non-partisan legislative races, Board of Education to your local school boards, it's 1 of ONLY 2 times this year to make your VOICE heard. But what is also happening is the amazing connections at the doors that will develop relationships for years to come. I know everyone is busy...work, planting season, school, sports, graduations, Mother's Day...but this is GO TIME!
Do you have a plan to VOTE? Does your County have plans to Get-Out-The-Vote (GOTV)? Can you make #OneMore call, text, email, Social Media post, letter to neighbor, or Coffee w/ a Friend to get a Republican to vote? When you go to church this weekend, WILL you remind everyone of their civic duty to vote?
EASY way to start the conversation on voting...don't ask WHO they are voting for...ask them HOW they are voting. Get the conversation going that implies they are GOING to vote and which way they prefer to vote.
Otherwise...will you look back on May 15th and say "I should've" done more! Give everything you got this week to encourage Republicans to VOTE?
I would estimate that we are well over 3000 County Delegates and might hit 4000 once I see all the lists. 500-600 Republicans will attend our State Convention. This is HISTORIC growth for our party and brings the stability needed to make a difference especially in local elections.
4000 Republicans that said, "Enough is enough with the direction of America!"
4000 Republicans that said, "I'm ready to be all in on 2024 and bring my time, talents and treasures to the table to further our principles in Nebraska!"
Imagine what great work can be done to support the objectives of the party with 4000 local volunteers! This will be the topic of upcoming Coffee newsletters, because we have the programs and resources to get 4000 volunteers and MORE into a structure/system where they will be appreciated, valued, and heard.
I wanted to leave the following information in this email just like last email for us to understand the numbers of where and how we can win elections. We have so much opportunity in 2024 and I can't wait to share more of the growth and stability that is occurring at the local level GOP's. If we focus on connecting to the voters, using Nebraska Values and a handshake, I'm confident that we will have a success 2024 campaign season.
Look at our Legislative District voter registration makeup and Congressional District makeup. We OUTNUMBER the Democrats in 38 out of 49 Legislative Districts! 5 of the 49 Districts are within a few votes of being in our favor! IF we commit ourselves to growing the Republican Voter base in 2024, we will have a super majority in our Unicameral. This effort should translate outward to all local races such as school boards and County races AND translate upwards to races for Board of Education and Federal. Also, since the ODD numbered Legislative Districts (1, 3, 5, etc.) are always up for election or reelection in a Presidential year, we should take EXTREME advantage of 2024's voter turnout. Every presidential year by in large more voters turnout, so we should always be gaining or retaining elected seats in those years.

Have you heard these phrases over the past six months?
> _" Don't start wars you can't win." _
> _" There was a ceasefire on 10/6."_
> _" Maybe Palestinians should've thought of their children being bombed before they attacked Israel on 10/7."_
These comments, and many more cruel comments like them, have inundated the social media spectrum, the media landscape, and politician talking points since 10/7. But there's only one problem with these comments--none of them are grounded in reality and none of them help us get to a place of peace and security for Israelis and Palestinians.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..rCPgZQr2CkpsK78ZdKELfARvN8BCAgyvJwHXRM3yJyQ?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144458026)
Where we are now is a far journey from where we have to go. Sadly, after denying a deal for ceasefire and release of all hostages, Israel is now planning a full on [invasion of Rafah](https://substack.com/redirect/117fb08a-b5c7-4769-a3ec-cd136d35473a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Doing so would be catastrophic to 1.2 million already displaced Palestinians, including some 600,000 innocent children.
Over the past six plus months Israeli bombing has killed more than 34,000 Palestinian civilians with some 70% of them women and children. During this time, I have come to realize that I cannot logically discuss Israel/Gaza with people who believe this current atrocity began with Hamas's war crimes on 10/7. And yes, I say unequivocally that Hamas killing Israeli civilians is a war crime and indefensible. And, I add that labeling 10/7 as the ignition to this conflict, and not part of a decades long trail of violence, isn't just false, it is dangerous to both Israelis and Palestinians. It falsely assumes life before 10/7 was peaceful for Palestinians and Hamas's violent attack on Israel occurred in a vacuum. Reality paints a vastly different picture that we cannot ignore.
Therefore, if we start with the premise that we want peace for Israel and for Palestine, then we must recognize the historical injustices leading up to the present day violence, and then collaborate to undo those injustices.
**First, we must recognize Israel 's 57 year illegal military occupation of Palestinian territories for the illegal act it is.** As Agnes Callamard, Amnesty International's Secretary General, [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/492e1eb7-59a3-4d7d-9d07-b76afb282a5b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> The world must recognize that ending Israel's illegal occupation is a _prerequisite_ to stopping the recurrent human rights violations in Israel and the [Occupied Palestinian Territories]. _Israel 's occupation of Palestine is the longest and one of the most deadly military occupations in the world_. For decades it has been characterised by widespread and systematic human rights violations against Palestinians. The occupation has also enabled and entrenched Israel's system of apartheid imposed on Palestinians. Over the years, Israel's military occupation has evolved into a perpetual occupation in flagrant violation of international law.
**Likewise, we must recognize that Hamas is not an ancient organization, but having been[established only in 1987](https://substack.com/redirect/3e52adf0-c1c3-49d4-8c50-67ec56501b70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), it is a **_**reaction**_**to more than 20 years of illegal occupation and land grab.** It also means recognizing that Hamas funding came with the approval and support of Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu as a way to delegitimize Palestinian statehood. As Times of Israel [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/f00f615b-824e-4e98-ba4b-da50eaf5e2fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> For years, the various governments led by Benjamin Netanyahu took an approach that divided power between the Gaza Strip and the West Bank -- bringing Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas to his knees while making moves that propped up the Hamas terror group. The idea was to prevent Abbas -- or anyone else in the Palestinian Authority's West Bank government -- from advancing toward the establishment of a Palestinian state.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..rCPgZQr2CkpsK78ZdKELfARvN8BCAgyvJwHXRM3yJyQ?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144458026)
**We must further recognize Israel 's 700,000 illegal settlements as the violation of international human rights law that they are, as repeatedly affirmed by the United Nations.** For example, see this UN Press release on [September 27, 2023](https://substack.com/redirect/5366d7ee-b530-43b5-be5e-e46e4336426d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), just 10 days before the 10/7 attack, citing the strong opposition to Israel's illegal settlement expansion by none other than the United States itself:
> The representative of the United States said the ongoing violence between Israelis and Palestinians sets back prospects for peace and is responsible for "so much needless suffering". Voicing concern over the situation in Israel, the West Bank and Gaza, she said the United States opposes the advancement of settlements and urges Israel to refrain from those actions, emphasizing that it undermines "the geographic viability of a two-State solution, exacerbates tensions and further harms trust between the two parties".
**Moreover, we must recognize that two decades of Israel 's land, air, and sea blockades on Gaza have left people desperate and distressed, and [violates international human rights law](https://substack.com/redirect/b50c7d7b-d949-4d91-944d-d300e2f086ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).**
**Justice furthermore means recognizing that some 9500 Palestinians are indefinitely detained in Israeli prison in what is known as** _**administrative detention**_**, many without charge or opportunity for release.** As NPR [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/86c6ec67-3d38-4f76-a0f4-6a9181e58f18?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Administrative detention is a form of detention whereby individuals are detained by the state [of Israel] without any intent to prosecute them in a trial, and they're held on the basis of secret security information that the detainee and their lawyer cannot review. Israel has been using this form of detention since its occupation of the West Bank and the Gaza Strip - so back to 1967.
**Yet additionally, it means recognizing that as you read this, up to 1000 Palestinian children are indefinitely detained in Israeli prison, again without charge, under so-called** _**administrative detention**_**.** These imprisoned children are further denied access to counsel or parents, while suffering ongoing physical and sexual abuse. As Save the Children International [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/2e891e04-d5c8-4cc4-a37d-9b345390b34a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Palestinian children in the Israel military detention system face physical and emotional abuse, with four out of five (86%) of them being beaten, and 69% strip-searched. Nearly half (42%) are injured at the point of arrest, including gunshot wounds and broken bones. Some report violence of a sexual nature and some are transferred to court or between detention centres in small cages. It is estimated that there are between 500 and 1000 children held in Israeli military detention each year.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..rCPgZQr2CkpsK78ZdKELfARvN8BCAgyvJwHXRM3yJyQ?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144458026)
**Justice means recognizing that for as much as critics like to claim "there was a ceasefire on 10/6," in the year prior to 10/7 the Israeli military [killed at least 240 Palestinian civilians in the West Bank](https://substack.com/redirect/b532ed77-fced-422e-b81b-44225ffbad66?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) where there is no Hamas.** That death toll included 47 children. In fact, it was the deadliest year in recent history for Palestinian civilians.
All of the above is but a snapshot of the injustices preceding 10/7. Yet almost none of it is discussed in the media and political ether, and we are all worse off as a result.
Thus, back to my original point--**if any person wants to have a serious discussion on Israel and Palestine, but only started paying attention on 10/7, then that person is not engaging in good faith, period.** Indeed, even since 10/7, Amnesty International reports that the [Israeli military has killed more than 300 Palestinians in the West Bank](https://substack.com/redirect/cdb2b3bd-7a28-4fef-9abc-d9664387033a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), where there is no war or Hamas. And I am willing to bet that for most readers, this is the first you've heard of it.
Thus, the refusal to engage in good faith dialogue that accounts for historical reality is harmful to both Palestinians and Israelis, because such ignorance and denial of history prevents building a just and sustainable future.
In the present moment, we can ensure and pursue peace through diplomacy, upholding international human rights law, and being just arbiters. That means stopping arms to Israel--a step [President Biden is finally taking](https://substack.com/redirect/ea8fc0d2-cbe0-4294-873d-555371a1ff33?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--to end the siege on Gaza. It means recognizing the injustices preceding 10/7, and working aggressively to actively undo them, i.e. an end to the Israel's illegal military occupation of Palestinian lands, an end to Israel's illegal settlements on Palestinian land, ample resources to rebuild Palestine and Gaza, and just leadership to ensure Palestinians have their own state and right to self determination--without foreign interference.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..rCPgZQr2CkpsK78ZdKELfARvN8BCAgyvJwHXRM3yJyQ?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144458026)
Bad actors from Hamas and the Israeli government who targeted civilians should face ICC prosecution, and the US and UN should apply pressure equally to ensure Israelis and Palestinians can live in peace and security beyond the clutches of corrupt politicians. No one is arguing that Palestinians have been flawless the last 57 years, but an occupied people shouldn't have to be to ensure their basic human rights to life and liberty are protected under international human rights law.
**As a human rights lawyer who believes international human rights law is a force for good, I seek nothing more than the safety and security of both Palestine and Israel, of Palestinians and Israelis.** But to get to that point, we must first recognize the history of this conflict before 10/7, and demand justice and fairness for all parties on and after 10/7. Cruel quips won't stop the atrocities we are witnessing daily, but upholding international human rights law, recognizing the history that got us here, and staying fiercely committed to justice to get us to where we need to go, can, and will create peace for both Palestine and Israel.
And that is a conversation worth having and acting upon.

Fellow Patriot,

My far-left opponent, Sherrod Brown has shown his true colors – and they’re not red, white, and blue. _ \*\*They’re stained with hypocrisy and weakness.\*\* _

\*\*First ➜\*\* Brown sank to a new low by endorsing the despicable antisemitic, pro-Hamas protests and encampments spreading like wildfire across our college campuses.

\*\*Then ➜\*\* He refused to call these pro-Hamas terrorist sympathizers what they are: _They’re vile, violent, antisemitic radicals who spread chaos and division._

\*\*Now ➜\*\* Brown shamelessly flip-flopped his stance after facing a mountain of backlash from Patriots like you and me, conveniently forgetting his initial nod of approval of these despicable acts.

-> \*\*FIRE HYPOCRITE SHERROD BROWN\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=6641565.2855.1.a79847044f73708141f054c900899f53 )<-

_ \*\*We are not fooled by Sherrod Brown's empty words and spineless pandering.\*\* _

_Let’s be crystal clear_: he’s shown that he’s willing to sacrifice principles for political gain, abandoning the rule of law in favor of appeasing the radical left. \*\*We can no longer allow anti-American politicians like this to represent us.\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=6641565.2856.1.72dabf545d3b7a80a4da113315203122 ) Ohio deserves better. America deserves better.

We deserve a Senator who will unwaveringly stand for law and order, who will never waver in the face of leftist pressure, and who will _ \*\*ALWAYS\*\* _ support American interests; not those of terrorist organizations keen on destroying our country.

I need you to stand with me, {{#if [FirstName]}}{{[FirstName]}}{{else}}fellow patriot{{/if}}, because Sherrod Brown will continue kowtowing to the radical Left – \*\*can you chip in 10 bucks now to fire him?\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=6641565.2857.1.eb3185bcdd53a7051708c460a67c2013 )

Thank you for your support.

For America,

( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=6641565.2858.1.64dc92d1cd2d40a179d378ed38d00a7d )

Bernie Moreno

GOP Nominee for Senate, Ohio

->

\*\*Meet Bernie Moreno:\*\*

( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=6641565.2859.1.22ff6cecb2f68c1f6b5e0d99a6bd466b ) Bernie Moreno fights for the American Dream because he’s lived it. Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18.

Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America.

In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board.

After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation.

Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First.

Ohioans are done with politicians who talk a big game and do nothing. Bernie wants to go to D.C. to get work done – just like he always has.

After all the horrors of his presidency and everything that has come out about his mistreatment of women, nobody should be supporting Donald Trump, let alone members of Congress.

Peter, I know you're just as fed up as I am with the chaos and division that Donald Trump and his allies – _including Mariannette Miller-Meeks_ – continue to sow across our country.

It's truly mind-boggling to me how Miller-Meeks can still stand by Trump's side after hearing about some of the _appalling_ proposals he wants to implement if he wins this November.

**Donald Trump's plans are nothing short of horrifying.** He wants to deport MILLIONS of Americans, set up migrant detention camps, and even allow states to prosecute women for receiving abortions. **These are not the actions of a leader who cares about the well-being of our country or its people.**

And let's not forget the countless women who have bravely come forward to accuse Trump of sexual abuse. Today marks the first anniversary of a jury finding Trump liable for sexually assaulting E. Jean Carroll in 1996. **It's truly sickening that someone with such a history of abusing women could still have support from Miller-Meeks.**

After all the horrors of his presidency and everything that has come out about his mistreatment of women, **nobody should be supporting Donald Trump, let alone members of Congress.**
