Hi Friend,
I hope this Spring finds you healthy and rejuvenated! My first months as your City Councilmember have been busy and productive. It’s been an honor to hear so many of your stories, hopes, and concerns as I’ve traveled all across Philadelphia.
It’s so important to me that I continue to hear your thoughts and priorities , especially during this busy budget season. I would love it if you could respond to this email to let me know how you think we are doing and where we should be headed. I need eyes and ears across the City and beyond in order to do my best work.
With PA’s primary election behind us , please take a moment to check on your voter registration by clicking HERE [https://www.pavoterservices.pa.gov/pages/voterregistrationstatus.aspx] . It is essential that we all work toward the General Election in November with urgency. Check your registration and register a friend today!
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP59/1/106735/images/Screen%20Shot%202024-05-07%20at%201.37.07%20PM.png]
Over the past few months, we have been diligently holding budget hearings and fighting for the improvements that our citizens are calling for. Thank you to each of you who has actively participated in this process . Your input and passion is being heard and we need you to stay involved!
In addition, I have recently introduced and passed several important Resolutions in Council - celebrating the life and legacy of trailblazing physician Edith Peterson Mitchell , urging the United States government to take immediate action to protect and enshrine abortion access for all birthing people, and honoring the founding of Sigma Pi Phi, Inc .
I am particularly proud to share that we held a Joint Hearing by the Committees on the Environment and Global Opportunities and the Creative/Innovative Economy on a resolution I introduced to lo ok at the reliability and servicing of publicly accessible electric vehicle charging stations in the City of Philadelphia. I am invested in making our city a premier city for environmental sustainability as we strive toward achieving our 2050 goal of net zero carbon emissions!
As always, I am endlessly optimistic for Philadelphia and deeply grateful for your support. I carry you with me each and every day.
I look forward to hearing more from you and ask for your continued partnership in the hard work of improving the lives of every Philadelphian. I know that we can do this together!
Thank you again,
Councilmember Nina Ahmad

clean_body: As gym-goers across America flee Planet Fitness after a string of incidents with transgender men in the women's locker rooms, | | | | Fellow Conservative, As gym-goers across America flee Planet Fitness after a string of incidents with transgender men in the women's locker rooms, I have an important question to ask you... What would you do if you saw a fully-grown man - wearing a female bathing suit - watching two little girls undress in the ladies' locker room? I'm going to tell you what a grandmother in Washington State did. - My friend, 82-year-old Julie Jaman has lived in Port Townsend, Washington for almost forty years. She regularly uses her local YMCA swimming pool. But all that changed suddenly... One day after Julie went for her regular swim, she entered the women's locker room to shower and change. While in the shower, Julie heard a male voice so she pulled back the shower curtain to see what could possibly be going on. | This grandmother became public enemy #1 for confronting a man she believed was preying on two little girls. Help us defend her today. | | | | That 's when she saw a fully-grown man in a women's bathing suit watching two little girls as they undressed. The children appeared to be around four and six years old, and Julie believed she may be witnessing a predator in action. Julie did what any reasonable grandmother would do. She confronted the man and asked him to leave. But instead of putting Julie's concerns to rest, YMCA staff rushed in and began berating Julie for her "discriminatory" response to a man (who identifies as a woman) helping little girls undress. On the spot, the YMCA banned Julie from that YMCA for life , the police were called to kick her out of the building, and THEN the YMCA launched a sophisticated smear campaign to paint Julie as a bigot and transphobe in her community. What on earth are we doing as a country when a grandmother trying to protect children becomes public enemy #1? My name is Harmeet Dhillon and I am the founder and Chief Executive Officer of the Center for American Liberty - the conservative non-profit organization underwriting Julie's case. The way the YMCA treated a concerned grandmother isn't just outrageous - it's unconstitutional. Like you, Julie has a First Amendment right to speak her mind no matter who disagrees with it. And like you, she has a Fourteenth Amendment right to due process - something the YMCA working with the City of Port Townsend - neglected when they banned Julie for life without even hearing her side of the story. In response to this blatant disregard for the Constitution, the Center for American Liberty sent a demand letter to the YMCA and the City of Port Townsend on Julie's behalf threatening a lawsuit if Julie's lifetime ban is not immediately lifted. I don't know how the YMCA will respond to our warning. But I do know that we can't stay silent as the Left attacks our most basic freedoms. Here at the Center for American Liberty , our unique strategy is taking down the Left. In fact, we have already won THREE Supreme Court cases. The Center for American Liberty is honored to fight in the courts to protect your freedom to say what you want, to live according to your conscience, and to pass on your conservative values to the next generation. But we need your help. If the YMCA and Port Townsend decide to stand their ground, we are going to have a major First and Fourteenth Amendment battle on our hands that impacts freedom for all of us. No doubt, giant liberal groups like the ACLU will try to join the fray in a high-profile case like this and try to intimidate us. We must have resources ready to go when that day comes. That's where you come in. If the YMCA and Port Townsend come to their senses, reinstate Julie's membership, and we don't have to take them to court - know that the Center for American Liberty will use your generous gift to win our other cases defending religious liberty, fighting to stop government censorship of conservatives, protecting parental rights and of course, defeating the radical transgender agenda. No matter what, I am counting on you to help us keep fighting the radical Left and its disgusting attacks on our children, our freedoms, and our Constitutional rights. Thank you in advance for your generous support. God Bless, | | Harmeet K. Dhillon Founder & CEO | | | P.S. Teachers give hours of their own time, outside of the school day, to volunteer for extracurricular activities that expand opportunities for the children in their communities. They spend money out of their own pockets to ensure their classrooms have everything their students need. And they give our children the guidance and support they need to be set up for success.

**_[Please, sign your name to let our hardworking educators know we see and appreciate all of the outstanding work they are doing for future generations.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84614368/472085070/1954547167?source=EM_NBI_BWC_20240507_PT_TAW_0_3MO_Bonnie_NA_NA_TAW&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDY4NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZTFmZjU4ZS0xMzBlLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZMYGhFJhlZl-u3t5jpefivyEyAcoY-cjGpFIJW7F43E=&emci=418d2eba-110e-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=9e1ff58e-130e-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=30096098)_**

While we show our appreciation this week, we must also recognize that teachers’ work is a day-in, day-out commitment that demands their full investment. Educators deserve our full support and I’ve been proud to spend my entire career fighting to give it to them.

Thank you for joining me in the fight this week,

Bonnie

I was proudly elected in 2022 to serve Texas in Congress.

Hey - my name is Byron Donalds.

As Co-Chair of one of the most important initiatives of the Republican Party, I wanted you to what we're doing right now to lay the groundwork for the biggest GOP landslide in AMERICAN HISTORY!

_**[A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen- so bear with me for a minute:](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f21e33f5da2d4c44bd0e338867331b7d&_e=eoQqOhTeHUNZxldpveWInuo5K6RwJeyi6ZWiMfr6V_xuE-LXImuT3dvdpZyMCoO55KY0OGFXaXtskoTKJpCCXaQ5beFSkKQalrpOwn3cJuJBYRUR_GlRApQBLJ44dHZ6EVgs-VQ9j7mWDe-bpvFagwy6S6MkcCWrtno__aj1A_KFRARmFIKPpfyhOPgISZwroULUjfgPD8nLAV5IFClBryJwUZWExF_XHowo2GAOyxGA5O2dQ1Jwqw04CNRiI4fJDmfos4TkHf40ztTk8hMy-FOTLktVoyQmR6K_2eXRGcFK3xyIpIveCp4x0a1NPjQtFTqX0ECdKcp5hcVMpgB3ynLSSdGRZLsg87LD-Z47AIQTq6qj_6cU9g1vsp4MwFD-LYI08JnqktHvph5Fy5vlCmb-1HplKNuPdYdj_TPnE_hObVCbeWicLIeBgum5eWvgxP6gURDvJ-PuXqgu7NJRHQ%3D%3D "A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen – so bear with me for a minute:")**_

-> If the Democrat Legal Machine tries any shenanigans, we'll be there to stop them
-> If Liberals can ballot harvest, we should ballot harvest even better
-> If they're sending poll watchers, we should send an army of our own
-> We're not pandering to minority voters, we're building relationships with them
-> We're expanding GOTV efforts to get young Conservatives to the ballot box
-> We're fighting bad election laws to make it easier to vote but harder to cheat

These are the nuts and bolts of winning campaigns up and down the ballot. And I'm proud to help lead these efforts.

As Conservatives, we have the issues on our side. We are the only commonsense Party. **If we get these campaign operations right, the Democrats are in serious trouble come election day.**

_But I have to be honest with you: building this level of infrastructure is very expensive._ We're running ads in costly swing-state markets, printing campaign literature, filling up gas tanks to knock doors, recruiting volunteers, and scaling up our voter contact programs.

And unlike the Democrats, we don't rely on Liberal billionaires and rich celebrities for funding.

I'm perfectly okay with that. But it means if we want to WIN BIG, the burden falls on all of us to step up. _**[That's why I'm coming to you now - would you be willing to pitch in a few bucks to help kick start these efforts? Whether it's 10 bucks or 100 bucks, I only ask that everyone pitches in SOMETHING.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f21e33f5da2d4c44bd0e338867331b7d&_e=eoQqOhTeHUNZxldpveWInuo5K6RwJeyi6ZWiMfr6V_xuE-LXImuT3dvdpZyMCoO55KY0OGFXaXtskoTKJpCCXaQ5beFSkKQalrpOwn3cJuJBYRUR_GlRApQBLJ44dHZ6EVgs-VQ9j7mWDe-bpvFagwy6S6MkcCWrtno__aj1A_KFRARmFIKPpfyhOPgISZwroULUjfgPD8nLAV5IFClBryJwUZWExF_XHowo2GAOyxGA5O2dQ1Jwqw04CNRiI4fJDmfos4TkHf40ztTk8hMy-FOTLktVoyQmR6K_2eXRGcFK3xyIpIveCp4x0a1NPjQtyqy5Zggk7-kDB_8AfGGwUpAzuh5uO_XV-6zCSN9567l44aQtTS7hmj6PFWXyph0icOqMqu4MBO-DMaf0sGrLinI8BeMo8GwRtmbPMIj0RIr7ghkWKCSX83liT70ONvt7UR8NctHpzCYXIhdnulK4YA%3D%3D "That’s why I’m coming to you now – would you be willing to pitch in a few bucks to help kick start these efforts? Whether it’s 10 bucks or 100 bucks, I only ask that everyone pitches in SOMETHING.")**_

Look,

**I know it 's a lot to ask but I GUARANTEE it'll all be worth it when we expand our Conservative Majority, take back control of the Senate, and win the White House.**

I don't know about you but the thought of unified Republican control fires me up! If that doesn't convince you to want to help, I don't know what will! Are you in?

There are three main parts to the National Domestic Workers Bill of Rights.
**1\. Ending the exclusion of domestic workers from core workplace protections:** This includes overtime pay, protection from workplace harassment and discrimination, paid sick days, protections for live‐in workers, and privacy protections.
**2\. Addressing the unique challenges of domestic work:** This includes written agreements, standards boards, fair scheduling, meal and rest breaks, and a National Domestic Worker Hotline.
**3\. Ensuring that rights are enforced:** This includes preventing retaliation, educational resources about rights, and an implementation task force.
**It's time to win justice, dignity, and respect for care workers — that means we need Congress to step up.**

clean_body: Hi Peter, We need your help to pass the National Domestic Workers Bill of Rights. This bill would extend and expand workplace rights and protections for care workers nationwide. There are three main parts to the National Domestic Workers Bill of Rights. 1\. Ending the exclusion of domestic workers from core workplace protections: This includes overtime pay, protection from workplace harassment and discrimination, paid sick days, protections for live‐in workers, and privacy protections. 2\. Addressing the unique challenges of domestic work: This includes written agreements, standards boards, fair scheduling, meal and rest breaks, and a National Domestic Worker Hotline. 3\. Ensuring that rights are enforced: This includes preventing retaliation, educational resources about rights, and an implementation task force. It's time to win justice, dignity, and respect for care workers — that means we need Congress to step up. In solidarity, Care in Action

[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1a4251f312fd430eb3f163495a527984&_e=p6ISf4tYPZ511dRWCcStZE3Na2Rkmxd3fWAAUgZpK75S3qNOhWYQHxHo1IrWy-GJMl5D0OD3CaUF2Aj8jIuTfzbxM7Pk1zQ6B6-HggM_KqVtHZZTe-6pyW85BTJw2TnHdqmBSJRBkVEP7xFv1Ye7ZnxyGzggKGq_GbCy7C4tF5w5U71lZosKGkH8rdXZRcCzSVgmrcL_K3hNl3BAxDMtypOx9KG-d9Fj-bSWj8vXVW-vGEoT5pHpJ-HGMVf85Gw0ekMYbd9bUPAvt42xy2ET0aYJJAgBTFEniatDlJymDBMuWv5cy3WqJ0wY2-EQ6AiXMBB3SM7859u4Cwik8cyIcoHCGiVOkk4dQ1uXLAPYsb3WZB3-JKPJeIOr8fmb5A27eDevSLDMAysc_qHXIJebww%3D%3D)
---
| Dear Fellow Patriot,

I believe that America stands at a crossroads. Our individual freedoms, the nation's respect for the Constitution, and the legacy of our Founders are all enduring relentless assaults. Shifts in our society threaten to dilute our nation's character while biased media and divisive politics amplify it greater than ever.

The people that this impacts the most are not you and I-_It is our future generation._ Our children and grandchildren are being taught that that is their skin that defines them, not the content of their character. They are being taught that our nation's history is something to be ashamed of. [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1a4251f312fd430eb3f163495a527984&_e=p6ISf4tYPZ511dRWCcStZE3Na2Rkmxd3fWAAUgZpK75S3qNOhWYQHxHo1IrWy-GJMl5D0OD3CaUF2Aj8jIuTfzbxM7Pk1zQ6B6-HggM_KqVtHZZTe-6pyW85BTJw2TnHdqmBSJRBkVEP7xFv1Ye7ZnxyGzggKGq_GbCy7C4tF5w5U71lZosKGkH8rdXZRcCzSVgmrcL_K3hNl3BAxDMtypOx9KG-d9Fj-bSWj8vXVW-vGEoT5pHpJ-HGMVf85Gw0VneuXCU9kMyLtgu6bQ4PUy0biCVJcVtRc3MPnhyPpXzZGn9boOG5WupAv1BMUTpmM2T3Agtqr478hKbzsrSuroHzPzrT76WCUIyH1VTzLenMTXhOq6Ui2iaPFWo1nd7KgafCAvj3_dOiUyWSiwKcXA%3D%3D) Candidly, it just doesn't make any sense.

But, I believe we can change this. I believe we can build a future that upholds the values of faith, liberty, community, and life - a future where all Americans are free to pursue their ideas, goals, and faith.

This won't be possible without your involvement. I've created a simple pledge; a way to align us all around a set of shared beliefs. body:
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1118%2E791427%2EpRwgpr)
Friends -
I'm reaching out this morning to respectfully ask if you can **[make a contribution — of $3 or any amount — to my campaign today.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-may24.KcBh3H&refcode=em240504-1-t2&t=2&akid=1118%2E791427%2EpRwgpr)
Here's why:
When I first ran for Congress in 2018, I decided to reject money from corporate PACs and billionaires. At the time, people saw it as a big move, but to me, it was barely a decision at all.
My team and I felt that the _only_ way we could build a movement and run a campaign that stuck true to our shared progressive values was to lead by example. And that started by funding it all the right way — together.
Since then, hundreds of thousands of supporters from all across the country have stood by my side and proven us right. That together, a mass movement of everyday working people could fund not just one, but three winning congressional campaigns $5, $15, and $50 at a time.
It will come as no surprise that running our campaigns this way requires a monumental grassroots effort, and that a significant portion of our budget each month comes from small-dollar donations made to emails just like this one.
_That's_ why I'm reaching out this morning. Because from time to time we need to ask, and today is one of those days:
**[Can you please make a contribution — of $3 or any amount — to stand with our re-election campaign for Congress today? I would not ask if your support were not so important to our success.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-may24.KcBh3H&refcode=em240504-1-t2&t=3&akid=1118%2E791427%2EpRwgpr)**
_If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your contribution will go through immediately:_
| | **[Donate $3](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/14?c0=io-em-may24.vHlicq&refcode=em240504-1-t2&t=22&akid=1118%2E791427%2EpRwgpr)**
---
****
| **[Donate $25](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/15?c0=io-em-may24.G4AfBH&refcode=em240504-1-t2&t=23&akid=1118%2E791427%2EpRwgpr)**
---
****
| | **[Donate $50](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/8?c0=io-em-may24.7TPvPe&refcode=em240504-1-t2&t=24&akid=1118%2E791427%2EpRwgpr)**
---
****
| **[Donate $100](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/9?c0=io-em-may24.MrE-C8&refcode=em240504-1-t2&t=25&akid=1118%2E791427%2EpRwgpr)**
---
****
| | **[Donate $250](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/10?c0=io-em-may24.atU-PH&refcode=em240504-1-t2&t=26&akid=1118%2E791427%2EpRwgpr)**
---
****
| **[Other Amount](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/13?c0=io-em-may24.nKhuVz&refcode=em240504-1-t2&t=27&akid=1118%2E791427%2EpRwgpr)**
---
****
Our opponents in this race — the dark money super PACs, the billionaires who fund them, right-wing special interest groups like AIPAC — they're gearing up to do and spend whatever it takes to defeat us.
Bigoted television ads blanketing the airwaves, attack mailers in every mailbox, conveniently-timed fundraising efforts for my opponent — it's all coming.
We know because they tried the same tactics against my friend Summer Lee in Pennsylvania before her victory last month. They're trying the same tactics against my friend Jamaal Bowman in New York as we speak.
As this election heats up in the months ahead, they're going to turn their focus toward our movement here in Minnesota — and you can be certain that they're not funding their work through small-dollar, grassroots donations.
It's going to take ALL of us standing together to fight back and defeat them. So please, I'm respectfully asking:
**[Can you use this link to make a contribution — of $3 or anything you can afford — to stand with our movement today? I rely on people like you to help fund this campaign.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-may24.KcBh3H&refcode=em240504-1-t2&t=28&akid=1118%2E791427%2EpRwgpr)
As always, thank you for everything. Not just for your financial support, but for your passion, your encouragement, and for all that you bring to our collective struggle for justice.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar

Hey everyone,
It's Don Davis here to share an important update with you.
In case you missed it, Roll Call recently named me as the fifth most vulnerable U.S. House member up for re-election [https://rollcall.com/2024/05/08/no-shortage-of-house-members-who-are-vulnerable-this-year/] .This might not come as a surprise since the N.C. General Assembly has redrawn the congressional map, making NC-01 the only competitive congressional race in the state. According to the Cook Report, our race is considered a "Toss-up!"
Despite all the attention, I'm confident of our path to victory. As a proud native of eastern North Carolina, I have deep roots in the East and understand the needs of our community. Our families are looking for a champion who will fight for good-paying jobs, work on lowering costs, and access to quality healthcare.
I have been doing this and delivering for our families throughout my time in Congress. Recently, I have worked tirelessly to secure $13 million to fund 15 community projects in 8 counties and there’s more to come. I'm on a mission to restore hope and our ability to live the American dream, and I intend to keep fighting.

**Building out our voter data and polling infrastructure for 2024 is more important than ever!**

Getting Lucas’ name and message in front of as many voters as possible is critical if we want to defeat Josh Hawley and flip this seat — and yard signs are a great way you can help us spread the word and show your support. If we blanket the state with these yard signs early on in this race, it’ll be a massive proof point for the strength of our grassroots movement. But we have to get started ASAP. (Once you’re done, we’ll send an email asking for your address to make sure we send it to the right place.) This is our shot to elect Lucas, take back Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat, and finally put real working people in charge of our country. And shows of support like this from people just like you are exactly how we’re going to make it happen. Thanks for helping us get it done, Team Lucas Kunce If you live in Missouri and would like to display a yard sign but are unable to make a donation at this time, | | Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri

I am writing today to ask you to make a donation directly to Jacky Rosen's campaign for Senate in Nevada.
The polls in Jacky's race are incredibly close, she's going to be facing huge amounts of outside spending against her, and control of the Senate and White House runs through Nevada.
If that's all you need to hear, use this link to donate to Jacky today. She really needs our help to pull this out:

Otherwise, I am asking you to make a donation to Jacky's campaign in the event Trump wins.
Sorry to put that thought in your head. But we have to consider it.
Trump gave an interview to Time Magazine that talked about his second term. It was the cover story titled "If He Wins." Did you see it?

He said he would let red states monitor women’s pregnancies and prosecute those who violate abortion bans.
He said he would pardon January 6 insurrectionists. Yes, these folks:

He said that he would deploy the National Guard in states and cities across the country as he wishes.
He said that he wouldn't even necessarily accept the results of this election if he loses.
So... Jacky Rosen. I'm asking you to donate today:
$5 because her opponent is a Trumper who will never vote to certify the election for Joe Biden after he's sworn in.
$5 because if Trump wins we will need a Democratic Senate to hold off his worst impulses.
$5 because help from all of us before Jacky Rosen has to make difficult spending decisions would make a world of difference for her.
So please:

name: Freedom First Project
subject: C.S. Lewis’s Profound Insights
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)
---
| | Dear Friend,C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith—making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That’s why we produced “[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._WG9cAbrjyBCFwdg)” which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis’s profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis’s The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis’s Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis’s beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis’s own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That’s why I hope you’ll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful DVD box set](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

I wanted to share a little bit about my story, and why I’m in this fight, Peter. To put it frankly, I represent one of the most competitive House seats in the country, so if you’re already with me, **[please chip in $8 or any amount you can afford right now to help me defend this seat:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84631347/472134994/-1839402663?refcode=email_050924_maybeyouknow&amount=8&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMmRlZDI4Ni0yNzBlLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nQekDCRZM4vQsCJgtXVp2DycYEqDqgnSI6-7ryIguiQ=)** | | [DONATE NOW →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84631348/472134995/-1839402663?refcode=email_050924_maybeyouknow&amount=8&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMmRlZDI4Ni0yNzBlLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nQekDCRZM4vQsCJgtXVp2DycYEqDqgnSI6-7ryIguiQ=)
---
**Family means everything to me.** My parents came to Colorado from a small town in Mexico, looking for a better life. They knew that hard work and caring for others are the values that build strong communities and families. They raised me and my siblings with those values — on a construction worker’s salary, in the home they still live in.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84631349/472134996/-1931070807?refcode=email_050924_maybeyouknow&amount=8&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMmRlZDI4Ni0yNzBlLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nQekDCRZM4vQsCJgtXVp2DycYEqDqgnSI6-7ryIguiQ=)
**I went to medical school, becoming the first in my family to graduate from college.** But even before I finished my medical training, advocacy became an important part of my life. I helped organize my fellow medical residents for better working conditions, and became a union representative with SEIU.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84631350/472135001/-1931070807?refcode=email_050924_maybeyouknow&amount=8&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMmRlZDI4Ni0yNzBlLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nQekDCRZM4vQsCJgtXVp2DycYEqDqgnSI6-7ryIguiQ=)
I chose to be a pediatrician in Adams County to give back to my community – to the folks that raised me. **I quickly realized that doctors face major obstacles when trying to treat our patients.**
**[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84631351/472135009/-1931070807?refcode=email_050924_maybeyouknow&amount=8&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMmRlZDI4Ni0yNzBlLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nQekDCRZM4vQsCJgtXVp2DycYEqDqgnSI6-7ryIguiQ=)**
**That’s why I ran for the state legislature.** In that time, I worked to pass legislation to force drug companies to lower the cost of prescriptions, expand funding for preschool, ensure all Coloradans have access to paid family leave and sick days, and protect renters from eviction during the pandemic.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84631352/472135017/-1931070807?refcode=email_050924_maybeyouknow&amount=8&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMmRlZDI4Ni0yNzBlLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nQekDCRZM4vQsCJgtXVp2DycYEqDqgnSI6-7ryIguiQ=)
And, Peter, that’s why I ran for Congress in 2022. **The pollsters said I didn’t have a shot of winning this race.** Thanks to this grassroots movement, we defied the odds and elected the first Latina to represent Colorado in Congress.
In Congress, I will continue my commitment to the families I see every day in Colorado. I will build on my work to lower health care costs, address the high cost of living, and protect a woman’s right to choose. [**I’m ready to continue advocating for Coloradans in Congress, but I can’t beat the far-right or get there alone. Your support was critical last time. So please, will you chip in to my congressional campaign today?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84631353/472135024/-1839402663?refcode=email_050924_maybeyouknow&express_lane=true&amounts=5,15,25,50,100,250&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMmRlZDI4Ni0yNzBlLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nQekDCRZM4vQsCJgtXVp2DycYEqDqgnSI6-7ryIguiQ=)

Peter,
Donald Trump is not a normal Republican or even a normal candidate for President. He has 91 felony charges. He _still_ refuses to accept the 2020 election results even after his failed January 6th insurrection. Distressingly, he recently refused to answer if there will be violence in November if he loses again.
**But you wouldn’t know that from looking at the news.** Here are some of the most recent headlines covering the presidential horse race:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84635764/472146626/2081106790?refcode=20240509-EM-TrumpNormal&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzNmNDVhMTktMmUwZS1lZjExLTk2ZjMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=t09bS6CP7igFtG7pW5Fb0tDY0pkIdEiGL5O7DeE8OYc=)
_USA Today_ claims they can’t tell who’s worse for democracy. _The Hill_ says both sides are out of line. _The New Yorker_ is rooting for a rematch as if it were a fight on _Real Housewives_.
**We don’t blame you if you’re concerned – we are, too.** The United States is sleepwalking its way into autocracy, and too many in the media are acting like they’ve learned nothing after nearly a decade of Donald Trump.
[**Peter, we’ll talk more about Trump’s alarming march to authoritarianism in a moment, but if you want to help us call out the mainstream media’s cowardly reporting in this crucial moment, can you chip in $15 now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84635772/472146629/-593472309?refcode=20240509-EM-TrumpNormal&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzNmNDVhMTktMmUwZS1lZjExLTk2ZjMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=t09bS6CP7igFtG7pW5Fb0tDY0pkIdEiGL5O7DeE8OYc=)
**Peter, even after trying and failing to overturn the election on January 6th, 2021, he recently claimed that he won Wisconsin, a state Biden carried by more than 20,000 votes.**
Election denialism has become so normalized among Trump’s base that the issue has become _the_ defining litmus test for Trump’s potential running mate.
**This weekend, Republican Senator and vice presidential candidate Tim Scott, once praised for his moderate views, refused to answer whether he’d accept the 2024 presidential election results if Trump lost. **
Scott’s refusal to commit to the peaceful transfer of power, a bedrock of our constitutional democracy, has disturbing echoes to the recent _Time Magazine_ interview, where Trump refused to rule out political violence if he loses.

Why? They’re worried about pissing off potential moviegoers and political backlash.
**It’s clear, whether it’s the media, the Republican Party, or Hollywood producers, far too many are cowardly ignoring their obligation to defend our democracy and our Constitution.**
At COURIER, we promise never to forget who Trump is: an autocrat who threatens the very existence of our Republic.
[**Here at COURIER, we prioritize fearless coverage that calls Trump precisely what he is: a dictator who will always put himself before his duty to our Constitution. As you may know, wolves are currently under federal protection in many states, including Colorado. This means that they may not be hunted and it is a federal crime to do so. The protections exist because wolves in the United States were hunted to near extinction.
__ | | | [](http://links.padoraforcongress.com/u/click?_t=1632d2fd715245289db23a5b99e588cb&_m=5932a6d7b38443709b7854590ad82b98&_e=Ixs0nYMKru9jbL9GsTmPQSgu63tDMfsxYPDBozNex0OXkBIdz5qlp8WSVoqi3eh4rytTZxnvLxFXg0tkltMOGai0rIZaBIBV41sb-kkmsaAf_w2EZ2IxNoF1gScKDL8pBJnDM1MuoeU4MwVxhvikt-d6EY1LhRybMVc87OOIcS-KL7bbX8GZCJpUSdYW8VZ0RaA2Xeoyb9N14LhRZpOwZJkx2eNvjrzqzHT6P_IigEuwvfWSpapaRKsFS0nPCKKhHyC6qt7FZ2Sd4R0NzMzhuY8snAOACsNkP3CI-MdVq23QYQOYgXBWW210D8knxNaF60UY8w5C_zxMXEtpz9Z_1VHOanTL9vnD23oLn3yUbOqgcpqVuvwrwZA55iO78qvcy8FYDwNWcqHT4IqCSpFd6w%3D%3D) Folks, As you may know, wolves are currently under federal protection in many states, including Colorado. This means that they may not be hunted and it is a federal crime to do so. The protections exist because wolves in the United States were hunted to near extinction. Now, Lauren Boebert sponsored a recently passed bill called the Trust the Science Act to get them delisted from federal protections. **There are currently only 10 wolves in the entire state and in 2020 that number had gotten as low as TWO.** The bill has zero chance of being signed by President Biden because allowing wolves to be hunted again would be the death sentence for them here in Colorado. I believe in environmental stewardship and protecting our animals and ecosystems. Killing wolves would be wrong and it’s gross that Lauren Boebert wants to pass this legislation. **[Will you stand with me in defense of Colorado’s wolves and chip into my campaign to defeat Lauren Boebert?](http://links.padoraforcongress.com/u/click?_t=1632d2fd715245289db23a5b99e588cb&_m=5932a6d7b38443709b7854590ad82b98&_e=Ixs0nYMKru9jbL9GsTmPQSgu63tDMfsxYPDBozNex0OXkBIdz5qlp8WSVoqi3eh4rytTZxnvLxFXg0tkltMOGai0rIZaBIBV41sb-kkmsaAf_w2EZ2IxNoF1gScKDL8pBJnDM1MuoeU4MwVxhvikt-d6EY1LhRybMVc87OOIcS-KL7bbX8GZCJpUSdYW8VZ0RaA2Xeoyb9N14LhRZpOwZJkx2eNvjrzqzHT6P_IigEuwvfWSpapaRKsFS0nPCKKh0kMNeZCWZz8G8HojQS94lRC4AzIzh0cRZwABWJfjdp81zz2ZomAOGfke9EtsqNUe0nEuPnaOcaxiB6jkN_bw3jF0jhaxm8Yu-gIPwpwfPqn_ecf_Ffy6rvlKNijBi09O9Kvjy9CZI5HoMu5cPcQdtA%3D%3D)** There’s something very dark about wanting to roll back protections from a group of animals that are nearly extinct already. And as a massive lover of nature, it really goes against everything I stand for and believe. **[So will you help me defeat Lauren Boebert and protect our wolves and wildlife by chipping in today?](http://links.padoraforcongress.com/u/click?_t=1632d2fd715245289db23a5b99e588cb&_m=5932a6d7b38443709b7854590ad82b98&_e=Ixs0nYMKru9jbL9GsTmPQSgu63tDMfsxYPDBozNex0OXkBIdz5qlp8WSVoqi3eh4rytTZxnvLxFXg0tkltMOGai0rIZaBIBV41sb-kkmsaAf_w2EZ2IxNoF1gScKDL8pBJnDM1MuoeU4MwVxhvikt-d6EY1LhRybMVc87OOIcS-KL7bbX8GZCJpUSdYW8VZ0RaA2Xeoyb9N14LhRZpOwZJkx2eNvjrzqzHT6P_IigEuwvfWSpapaRKsFS0nPCKKhfANKqWjAeXetkDXrB0s8Pc4sCmgAWMBsnE6M3zJ25lDOcHOAPxcnY5lnHkyTW5Q2qqAjhfKfXJ_UeoiuM-lxPi7JoGb3YMdfHmxFCojKotv1ohyYx-hrei1TxPjrVjcn3epR3MiNC4jDL36BbNiZaQ%3D%3D)** Best,

Siding with violent criminals over our brave police is a **CHOICE**.

---
| | | Dear Supporter:

Imagine your region with a media corps focused on truth-seeking reporting, providing a space to explore unconventional or disruptive ideas and viewpoints, and open dialogue on the issues facing our region.

That's what _Broad + Liberty_ is building in Southeast Pennsylvania, and we need [your support](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=c172781b9d&e=b7b3eddce2) to take our efforts to the next level.

We are building a publication with cross-platform reach that is influencing policy outcomes, informing the leaders who serve us, and resonating in the hearts and minds of our readers through news, editorials, and now multimedia content for those seeking straightforward perspectives grounded in reality.

**We couldn't do this without you – every dollar received is a spark that ignites change in our region and beyond.**

The work of _Broad + Liberty_ is essential in the movement for freedom – we are asking for your support to achieve our goals in the form of a [tax-deductible contribution](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=15b3aa44e5&e=b7b3eddce2) of any amount.

Thank you for your consideration,

The Editors at _Broad + Liberty_

I’ve endorsed Kevin because I know he will do a great job representing Ohio and ready to stand against the radical Democrats in Washington who want to ruin our way of life and destroy our country as we know it.

Kevin knows that America is the best place in the world to live, work, and raise a family. As a dad, he is willing to work as hard as it takes to help ensure the next generation's success. He knows northeast Ohio and he knows that everyday Ohioans demand courage from our political leaders.

He also knows that America’s success, and our leadership role in the world, are on the line with the way President Biden and his Democrat allies are running things in Washington. These liberals don’t share our values, don’t share our optimistic vision for the future, and frankly don’t view America like we do.

Radical leftists believe the idea of American exceptionalism is flawed, and our country is in need of fundamental, moral repair. Nothing could be further from the truth. Kevin Coughlin shares our belief that America must remain a beacon of freedom for the world, and that chaos ensues when America does not lead.

I’m standing with Kevin Coughlin because he knows what we are up against, and he has the courage to not back down when the Democrat smears against him and his family get going. With your help, Kevin will help me pass an “America First” agenda and STOP Democrats from passing any more of their out-of-control borrowing that is burying our country in centuries of debt.

body:
Judicial Watch announced recently that it filed a lawsuit to force
California to clean up its voter rolls. The lawsuit, filed on behalf
of Judicial Watch and the Libertarian Party of California, asks the
court to compel California to make “a reasonable effort to remove
the registrations of ineligible registrants from the voter rolls” as
required by federal law

body:

---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/84643160/472165634/-1368531592?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240509_1_2&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImJmMGE5NjJjLTM3MGUtZWYxMS05NmYzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=gBxHz1TzTU45eReOnPo_gcsY_sJrGbzy9OLEjZkUw4U=)

Hi Peter, this is Congressman Dan Goldman from NY-10. I was lead majority counsel during the first Trump impeachment trial — and since then, I’ve borne the brunt of many MAGA attacks.

I can’t believe I’m saying this, Peter, but **Marjorie Taylor Greene told me to ”shut the f*** up”.**

I’m past the point of being surprised by Marjorie Taylor Greene’s lack of decorum, but this might be a new low _— even for her._

During a House Oversight Committee hearing, Chairman Comer was yammering on about Republicans’ sham impeachment inquiry against President Biden. When I interjected, Marjorie Taylor Greene loudly told me to “shut up,” then moments later mouthed to me, “shut the f*** up.”

This is where today’s Republican Party stands, Peter. Majorie Taylor Greene’s behavior is not only normalized within the Republican Party _but is often even applauded._ It’s deeply concerning that Republicans can’t engage in political discourse without resorting to childish behavior.

subject: Yesterday’s Senate Judiciary hearing
body:

Help us reach 5,000 comments to overcome corporate polluters.? Tell the EPA:
PROTECT COMMUNITIES FROM CHEMICAL DISASTERS
The EPA is now seeking public input on a new rule to require industrial facilities to disclose the hazardous chemical risks posed by their operations, take stronger actions to prevent accidents, and move quickly should an accident occur.

Corporate polluters have already killed this rule once, when Trump decided to allow these dangerous facilities to operate in secrecy. We cannot allow them to succeed again.

GOAL: 5,000 actions
TAKE ACTION https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/04wrMWKPY0t_/SEF5K0NnblZmb2xlZ0phcHd5TGF1T2t6RHVJUGMwNmMvcVRaMXR3S1d5UmJMVkxacTVmYXIzSDYrWmF4UGRrVTBHWlZjM0ozdEpUZU5KYlNYQ2VvaXczZ1dVQ1phTUJVZkM1SmIwVnhjOUU9S0/Y1g3eTJUYnlkS1FwakpEaHg0MGNMRkI5OXdUZUlDN1Q1bEJtWlpUNUphSHNCQUpRWEZsRWNRMmNlWCtFd1pzTzZpWkxNckd2ZU1qSUNUdDhWa21UWktGOW5TMjhhbCtWUHRndHZXckh5WFk9S0 ? ?
? Peter ? a critical new rule from Biden's EPA would finally require dangerous industrial facilities to disclose any hazardous chemicals they contain ? and take steps to prevent and mitigate harmful accidents.

This rule will especially protect people living closest to these facilities, which are overwhelmingly low-wealth communities and communities of color, as well as workers. Decades of environmental racism ensured these hazardous facilities were located in the neighborhoods with the least resources to fight back, meaning these frontline communities are disproportionately exposed to chemical accidents and harmful pollutants that have jeopardized their health.

Here's the problem: powerful interests, like the oil and gas industry and the chemical industry, are demanding the EPA once again abandon these important protections. Unless our movement speaks up right now, we may miss out on this opportunity to advance environmental justice and worker safety, and create healthier communities and workplaces.

Please TAKE ACTION right now to protect communities from chemical hazards. To beat the chemical industry, we need to urgently deliver 5,000 comments supporting the EPA's proposed rule. https://links.messages.lcv.

We've already seen the dangers these facilities can pose. In 2013, an explosion of ammonium nitrate fertilizer killed 15 people and destroyed a school, nursing home, and many homes in the city of West, Texas. The Obama administration began a painstaking process to prevent similar disasters, culminating in enhanced protections for minimizing and managing chemical risks.

But after an aggressive campaign from the chemical industry and other corporate polluters, the Trump administration abandoned the rule, choosing to prioritize corporate profits over the health of vulnerable communities and workers.

Under President Biden, the EPA can now reverse this dangerous decision and finally help protect people, especially environmental justice communities, from hazardous pollution and chemical disasters.

Don't let corporate polluters undermine critical environment protections. TAKE ACTION now to help us deliver 5,000 comments supporting environmental justice and corporate accountability. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/z9e0fbXW_mC-/SEF5K0NnblZmb2xlZ0phcHd5TGF1T2t6RHVJUGMwNmMvcVRaMXR3S1d5UmJMVkxacTVmYXIzSDYrWmF4UGRrVTBHWlZjM0ozdEpUZU5KYlNYQ2VvaXczZ1dVQ1phTUJVZkM1SmIwVnhjOUU9S0/Y1g3eTJUYnlkS1FwakpEaHg0MGNMRkI5OXdUZUlDN1Q1bEJtWlpUNUphSHNCQUpRWEZsRWNRMmNlWCtFd1pzTzZpWkxNckd2ZU1qSUNUdDhWa21UWktGOW5TMjhhbCtWUHRndHZXckh5WFk9S0

Thank you for taking action to protect people and workers from environmental disasters.

Sincerely,

Madeleine Foote
Deputy Legislative Director

body:
Friend , it's with a heavy heart I’m reaching out to tell you that as of May 1, 2024, reproductive rights are effectively gone in Florida.
When the Florida Supreme Court upheld Ron DeSantis' already-unconstitutional 15-week ban last month, they gave the green light for his even worse six-week trigger ban to take effect.
Even when 1 in 3 people only find out they're pregnant after six weeks have already passed.
Even when there are almost no exceptions for rape and incest.
Even when 75% of Florida voters oppose such extreme measures.
We haven't even gone a full day under this law, but one day is too many. And I know I'm not the only one who thinks so: abortion is a winning issue, and we've seen it in every election, red state or blue, since Roe v. Wade was overturned.
So this is not the end of our fight for abortion rights. It's just the beginning.
We can save our pro-choice Senate majority and codify reproductive freedom nationwide, but it starts with kicking out extremists standing in the way, like Sen. Rick Scott. I'm fighting every day to defeat him, but I need your help to reach my emergency $100,000 goal and win. Will you split $15 between my campaign and Serve America before midnight tonight to help me flip Florida blue? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-dmp]
Look, friend: This ban has ripped away my rights, the rights of my two daughters, and the rights of millions of women who will be put in danger across our state.
And just so we're clear: It's all because of the Supreme Court that Donald Trump built, and the Senators who allowed him to appoint the anti-abortion extremists who went on to reverse the protections of Roe.
Senators like Rick Scott, who proudly says that, were he still governor of Florida, he would've signed that extreme six-week ban.
He's been living in a bubble of far-right extremists. He refuses to accept that the tides are turning in Florida, or that everyday families simply do not support his toxic, anti-choice agenda. That's why I'm running to retire him.
If I make it to the Senate, I'll do everything I can to pass legislation that reinstates abortion rights nationwide. But my opponent is a mega-millionaire who can and will spend practically anything to bankroll his attack ads and drown us out.
I need your grassroots support today because without it, I simply won't make it to the Senate. So please, if you're with me in the fight for our freedoms and against extremist, out-of-touch politicians desperate to control us, will you rush $15 — split between my campaign and Serve America — before midnight to help me make reproductive rights the law of the land once more? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-dmp]
Together, we will win.
Thank you,
Debbie

Democrats Shouldn’t Play Dirty Politics
It wasn’t Jack Bergman who tried to remove me from the ballot on a frivolous complaint clearly not applicable to a Congressional race [http://drbob.me/response] ; it was my democratic challenger herself, Callie Barr.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/Lorinser%20Face.png]
Whether it's $2, $20, or $200, you can help me fight these Trump-style tactics that interfere with the Democratic process.
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process immediately.
DONATE $2.24 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/q1bl?express_lane=true&amount=2.24&refcode=express_lane_2.24]
DONATE $20.24 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/q1bl?express_lane=true&amount=20.24&refcode=express_lane_20.24]
DONATE $202.40 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/q1bl?express_lane=true&amount=202.40&refcode=express_lane_202.40]
DONATE $2,024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/q1bl?express_lane=true&amount=2024&refcode=express_lane_2024]
Friends,
To a Yooper and a northern Michigander, this challenge smells like election interference, and I had to ask our election lawyers, “Why did she do this? Surely, she knew better.”
Dirty politics is likely the answer. My Democratic primary opponent appears to be desperately trying to sow voter doubt and throw me off my game. She wants to delay our fundraising efforts , as my team needed to spend valuable time and resources responding to her erroneous legal challenge.
We know the challenge will be dismissed, and I am no stranger to political adversity, but this one is beyond that. Am I disappointed in her conduct? Certainly.
Democrats are a party that celebrates democracy, not attacks it. I want to earn your vote, not manipulate it.
We will continue to campaign with integrity, honesty, and courage to represent all of us in Congress.
So, let's get back to talking about family sustaining wages, better jobs, healthcare, childcare, Social Security, immigration reform, public education, and energy independence while protecting our environment and addressing climate change at the same time.
When we improve these issues, the lives of hardworking everyday Americans improve, and these are the topics my campaign thrives on.
I am running for Congress for our families, our freedoms, and our future.
Please join me.
Whether through a generous contribution, your endorsement, or volunteering, I would be grateful for your help today. Thank you. [https://linktr.ee/boblorinser]
Onward,
Bob

Speak truth. Speak it with conviction. Speak it with a spine. Speak it with respect. Even when it's hard - especially when it's hard. | [](http://links.vivek2024.com/u/click?_t=07471d1165224e98aee1aca8cd71f6e2&_m=3aa150f017834ed9868796b90a1a2812&_e=fsZIw9mAf6n54YuA_YyUpUNzawyY2kqJQ6515se3oUequryBGmtr1HqMT30jeHkNUklCUi7RAz1LIki30N_nO7za3hjG3d3ceYYVhP-7v51tgWqSW_zF349N4S--fraRmiyNw2ofUvY7Ut4LArDKiPHRO_SgAF3gaO8vL7HcZKrhbHQVXgrMOEtrRPzE5EiFWutwqIlI4pA1-LWocFWdjBqawJu1hL-uEnxlzGm9wQk%3D)
Fellow American,

Yes, it's true. This week, on the TRUTH podcast Ann Coulter said it to my face: _"I agreed with many, many, things you said...in fact probably more than most other candidates when you were running for President, but I still would not have voted for you because you're an Indian._ "

**[Watch here](http://links.vivek2024.com/u/click?_t=07471d1165224e98aee1aca8cd71f6e2&_m=3aa150f017834ed9868796b90a1a2812&_e=fsZIw9mAf6n54YuA_YyUpc6htOiwmwbEQQQwWy-merSq0g49mEm4Y-1S7VAo1x6ErsoAz2qnaZlYpVSWGIsN-WMK6EcO7fQ54zyM5aJXWEgSXx4Dz35kbRPW8-mqJqEwPFUfb69iwXefASpIbZsTbydWkYohwDmGfApI6J7MWjtcAXjTNexfv3GyLjOs2Zymk0nRSZNxFZYM3PXjn1TtHjqkuThdUq0D4yT0Ir96aJw%3D)**. We had a riveting one-hour conversation after that opening exchange. **[LISTEN to the full podcast now.](http://links.vivek2024.com/u/click?_t=07471d1165224e98aee1aca8cd71f6e2&_m=3aa150f017834ed9868796b90a1a2812&_e=fsZIw9mAf6n54YuA_YyUpUNzawyY2kqJQ6515se3oUequryBGmtr1HqMT30jeHkNUklCUi7RAz1LIki30N_nO-FXoGIA6lsmf7eaJfRd8j18RMeXxJyzwOFE2RapKRUXxq22Knc8dNDSfp_H1Rql6t9rETVB0vgI8rgWLF33p6HQ8i1PZY--0ykTl4PDntg5X_a1GnOp25Qo3otjJAGnsFX6FNo7121PZbC9QvXUI_Y%3D)**

I took a hiatus after the campaign, and now I'm back in full force. We need to revive the conversations that most people are too afraid to have anymore. Raw yet respectful. Principled yet open-minded. If you want to hear standard conservative talking points, the TRUTH podcast isn't for you. But if you want to challenge yourself, this is a great place to start. **[Listen to a new episode each week.](http://links.vivek2024.com/u/click?_t=07471d1165224e98aee1aca8cd71f6e2&_m=3aa150f017834ed9868796b90a1a2812&_e=fsZIw9mAf6n54YuA_YyUpUsUUDREGSAyG_PUcp5dumR9wjKIRQ_FRuAntrzQWrppSe3nIOIzMVIy8tEDy6b9khXAC5MfMB-PKsplRKVvkXNmXufm0pYBSnQT06zSOtJ-JxLYNcRAV1at4025GxZQawXtcr_NCMapiQwJyiIgEMzKteJk463bxtvQy7s5yK96TwdOYQIWKIWs5oSrfm-A6CAvfJAXWEWVOjBTWXb4eyJhMe1JO3LUHfMaXPol3xJAtoJS1_dHGKG6Ypx3_51BKI69X05qjdFCN_37RgkWrkM%3D)**

Speak truth. Speak it with conviction. Speak it with a spine. Speak it with respect. Even when it's hard - _especially when it's hard_. **That's how we're going to get this country back.**

And that's the TRUTH.

See you next week,

Vivek Ramaswamy

name: Jill Stein
subject: “This is blood on JoeBiden’s hands.”

body:
Our urgent plea for Rafah.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=rafah&n=1)
---
Dear Peter,

Like all of you, I am sickened and outraged watching the latest horrors Israel is bringing down on Gaza.

The assault on Rafah is the grand finale of Israel and Joe Biden’s genocide.

For seven months Israel has systematically herded one and a half million Palestinians into Rafah like lambs led to slaughter. Israel lied and claimed Rafah was a “safe zone” for innocent civilians while they raided, bombed, and demolished every home and hospital in every other part of Gaza.

Right now, as Israel rains bombs down on Rafah and fires heavy artillery from tanks against tents housing over a million Palestinian refugees – including 600,000 children – **our president is acting more like an undersecretary for Netanyahu** than the commander in chief of the most powerful nation on Earth.

**Biden could stop this assault right now. His refusal to do so is one of the greatest moral failings of an American president in living memory.

** This is blood on Joe Biden’s hands. **[Click to watch my message in full.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate4peace?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=rafah&n=2)**
****
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate4peace?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=rafah&n=3)
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate4peace?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=rafah&n=4 "WATCH NOW") [WATCH NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate4peace?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=rafah&n=4)
---
For weeks now, Netanyahu and his ministers have insinuated their intent to invade Rafah. As ceasefire negotiations made progress and it was clear that an agreement was on the table, Israel stated bluntly that they would invade Rafah with or without an agreement.

This week the negotiators representing Hamas unilaterally accepted a ceasefire agreement brokered by Egypt and Qatar – **including a return of all hostages**. Hours later, Israel REJECTED this agreement and began their latest assault.

**Rafah was supposed to be Biden’s “red line” for Israel – but that, too, was a lie.** The simple fact is that Israel could not have committed these crimes without the active, ongoing assistance of the United States.

Ours is the only anti-genocide, anti-war, pro-climate action, pro-worker campaign slated to be on the ballot across the country in November. I need your help to guarantee that every American has the choice to vote for peace and an end to this slaughter. **[Please share this message, and give as generously as you can.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate4peace?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=rafah&n=5)**

I also ask that you **[consider a contribution to UNRWA](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=hv8dYCeGJ9MVGszQlAtA3A5sopJvcU_WBnRaWPFx16GvkDlQl5UME9AYc1CWvO9y&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=rafah&n=6)** , which despite this horrifying assault continues to perform courageous, lifesaving work for the people still trapped behind Israeli tanks in Gaza.

**This is not the time to talk about what we're _going_ to do. This is the time to DO everything in our considerable power to stop Israel’s indiscriminate murder and facilitate Palestine’s entry into the United Nations with full autonomy and sovereignty.

**Biden has failed the test. And Palestine has paid the price.

End the genocide. Free Palestine NOW.

In solidarity,

Jill

Peter,
One way big corporations stick it to middle class families is through so-called “junk fees.”
Overdraft fees. Credit card late fees. Early termination fees from phone and internet companies. Extra fees to sit with your family on flights. Service fees for concert tickets. These may sound trivial, but they add up to a lot for Americans already struggling to make ends meet.
A lot of politicians these days decry junk fees. Andrei’s actually done something about it. More than a decade ago, Andrei started an alternative to Wall Street Big Banks to help people have fair bank accounts that didn’t charge these kinds of fees. He helped millions of Americans be able to avoid hundreds of dollars a year by getting rid of ATM fees, overdraft fees, service fees, and late fees.
That’s why Andrei supports President Biden’s _Junk Fees Prevention Act_ to eliminate unfair and costly junk fees.
Junk fees not only cost consumers billions each year, they also stifle competition in our markets by making it impossible for consumers to accurately compare prices due to hidden costs. The plan to eliminate junk fees will even the playing field and give consumers better transparency into prices.

Wait until you hear about the phenomenal work Leaders We Deserve is doing.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240509-1&t=1&akid=673%2E587540%2ESnnTbn)
Peter,
Young Americans deserve leaders who understand the challenges they face: finding affordable housing, confronting the climate crisis, and preventing gun violence. And if we’re going to overcome the divisiveness and gridlock that’s stopping us from confronting these issues, we need to expand the pool of young people running for office.
That’s why I’ve been excited to support Leaders We Deserve in the work that they’re doing to elect more millennial and Gen-Z leaders to Congress and state legislatures across the country.
**That work can't happen without critical resources, Peter — and they're entirely grassroots funded.[That's why I'm personally reaching out to ask you to make a donation of $5 to Leaders We Deserve right now.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240509-1?refcode=em20240509-1&refcode2=673_587540_SnnTbn&akid=673%2E587540%2ESnnTbn)**
David Hogg and Kevin Lata launched Leaders We Deserve last summer, and they endorsed one of their first candidates, Nadarius Clark, in Virginia. Nadarius won his competitive race last November, and now, at 28, is serving as the state’s youngest House Delegate.
On gun violence, student debt, and many more issues, Nadarius has been working to bring renewed attention to the priorities shared by many young Americans. And if Leaders We Deserve succeeds, Nadarius will be the first in a long line of young leaders to come. Just recently in a hearing of the firearms and public safety committee that Nadarius Clark leads, he was able to strike down a bill to arm teachers. This would not have been possible without the one seat majority that Democrats gained with Nadarius’s seat this last November.
The work they’re doing gives me so much hope that we can build a more fair and more inclusive country. I can’t wait to see the wins to come and to lend a helping hand along the way.
But we can't take those wins for granted, Peter. The truth is the work Leaders We Deserve is doing can't happen without funding, and they rely entirely on grassroots donors like you to support their work.

body:

---
Peter
Representing your values is the most critical job our elected officials have. Many politicians seem more focused on personal gain than serving their community. We see it time and again with Trump and with his many followers like my Republican opponent and Colorado GOP chair Dave Williams.
The first thing I did after announcing my run for Congress was to pick up a phone. I started calling everyone I could to listen and learn how people were struggling in our community. I am running to be a public servant who advocates for the people. To do that, I need your help.
I want to hear about the issues that matter to you and learn how to fight for you in Congress. **I was hoping you could reply to this email or fill out the survey below. I want you to tell me what I should focus on in my first 100 days in office.**

[ From Bill Gates to Beijing: The Surprising Forces Threatening Black Farmers' Livelihoods ](https://u29682053.ct.sendgrid.net/ls/click?upn=u001.kgb8k8r0aUm-2BeMyB-2FPLFQNmjeD0taYFqeTt3zcFvYwKXvSHm5iMrbteQW0yD59Et8Mj3zKCpeYsxci-2BMNY8RZoJjbOue3hCasI3-2Fn0oBoF4-3DNWpG_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVBMGiuY9tQ0zBicS5T-2Fkm0R2tcU4l2-2BDLq7CH03VLYe1AiAJsNKLsLGUvOveuCw-2F1I7mQV5fBG-2FoCIijVWetvoq9riegcKwnHM-2BKoucju4LZbd-2FTgGaKsF4yh-2Ftwtd6KFpj9MqiJWmw2LVZkKOiazEI1Rk-2FSScyeqWXb-2BILsOnZ0jsdPSNqBtGwbwTJNDV2tO25M5svJLXNadgDblySgB0A3V7a65y3xpI6IUXVaEUgSE0sL-2B9-2FXnZnVIxOSKB6-2BlPBw52Z5Qb2v4aZA9ZnmOStuPF9BY-2BdE-2FLkRlfNJu5lHI4kugb5IhpWv-2BSkf5-2Buq0obzCwqAY3MZRynbD228p09HGh1f-2FGhFaMsTRkzLe-2BQXw-3D-3D) In the early 1900s, there were over 1 million Black farmers in the United States, owning around 20 million acres of land. Today, those numbers have dwindled to just 40,000 farmers and 3.5 million acres. This staggering loss can be attributed to decades of systemic discrimination, particularly within the USDA, as John Boyd, a Black farmer and civil rights activist, reveals in a powerful podcast interview.**Key Points:**
* Despite legal actions and settlements, many Black farmers have not received promised debt relief, continuing the cycle of land loss.
* Concerns are raised about the increasing foreign ownership of American farmland, particularly by China, and the influence of wealthy individuals like Bill Gates on the agricultural sector.
* Boyd expresses a commitment to advocating for the rights and support of all farmers, emphasizing the importance of agriculture to national well-being and security.

Found it on Common Sense Weekly \(Subscribe here: \.) ---|--- | []() | ---|--- | Laughter and Country Tunes Country & Comedy Night with RFK Jr. in Nashville A unique blend of comedy and country music awaits: 🎤 Enjoy appearances from stars like Rob Schneider, Jeremy Piven, and Russell Brand. 🎶 Listen to the musical talents of Kayley Bishop and John Carter Cash. 🎟️ Choose from various ticket options for an unforgettable evening. 🎉 Mix and mingle at the after-party with the performers and RFK Jr. 📆 Mark your calendar for May 15th for a night of laughter and music. | | | The affordable housing crisis is one of the most pressing issues facing our nation today. With corporations buying up single-family homes at an unprecedented rate, young and first-time homebuyers are finding themselves priced out of the market.Robert F. Kennedy Jr. understands the severity of this problem and has proposed a multi-faceted solution that includes changes to the tax code, low-interest mortgages, and targeted financial assistance.Why It Matters: The affordable housing crisis affects millions of Americans, particularly young and first-time homebuyers. By addressing the root causes of this issue and implementing targeted solutions, we can ensure that the dream of homeownership remains attainable for all, fostering stronger communities and a more stable economy. | | | ---|--- | []() | ---|--- America's soils have been poisoned, eroded, and depleted for a century, leading to a host of problems including chronic disease, ecological damage, polluted water, and rising food prices. Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has a plan to address these issues with regenerative agriculture.Key Points: Regenerative agriculture restores soil health, increases biodiversity, improves the water cycle, and produces healthy, toxin-free food. RFK Jr. will shift regulatory priorities to favor small farmers and regenerative practices, remove corporate influence from government agencies, and change agricultural subsidies. Under his leadership, America can expect a revitalized farm sector, lower food prices, better health, and a healthier environment. By healing the soil, we can improve public health, restore ecological balance, reduce food prices, and support the livelihoods of small farmers. | | | ---|--- | []() | ---|--- The Kennedy campaign is taking on criminal justice reform with a nationwide tour, "A New Dawn for Justice." This series of events, to be held in multiple cities, brings together activists, legal experts, and community leaders to engage in meaningful dialogue and advocate for comprehensive reforms. The events will combine panel discussions, workshops, and live performances designed to educate, inspire, and mobilize attendees. | | | ---|--- | []() | ---|--- The problem with modern political discourse is that it often lacks substance and fails to address the real concerns of the American people. Robert F. Kennedy Jr. aims to change that by challenging former President Donald Trump to a debate and forcing a conversation about the broken promises, policy failures, and questionable decisions that have characterized Trump's presidency. | | | ---|--- | []() | ---|--- | Evening of Influence Engage With Future Leader Kennedy Join us for an exclusive evening: 🍸 Savor delightful hors d’oeuvres and signature cocktails 🔥 Experience an intimate fireside chat with Robert F. Kennedy Jr. 🗨️ Engage in meaningful discussions during the Q&A session 📸 Capture your moment with a personal photo opportunity 🌟 Support a presidential campaign in an elegant setting | | | Is the proposed TikTok ban really about protecting American security interests, or is it just political posturing at the expense of free speech? Robert F. Kennedy Jr. believes it's the latter and is planning a legal challenge to fight what he calls a "catastrophic" attack on the First Amendment.Why It Matters: By challenging this ban, RFK Jr. is standing up for the rights of American youth to express themselves and pursue entrepreneurial opportunities online, free from politically motivated censorship. The outcome of this legal battle could have far-reaching implications for the future of free speech in the digital age. | | | ---|--- | []() | ---|--- Imagine having to take multiple bus rides with your toddlers in tow just to access a grocery store with fresh, healthy food. This is the reality for many Black mothers in underserved communities, and it's just one of the many socio-economic challenges that contribute to the shockingly high maternal mortality rate among Black women. Robert F. Kennedy Jr. believes that by addressing these underlying issues and investing in community-driven solutions, we can begin to close this gap and ensure that all mothers have access to the care and resources they need to thrive. | | | ---|--- | []() | ---|--- In the early 1900s, there were over 1 million Black farmers in the United States, owning around 20 million acres of land. Today, those numbers have dwindled to just 40,000 farmers and 3.5 million acres. This staggering loss can be attributed to decades of systemic discrimination, particularly within the USDA, as John Boyd, a Black farmer and civil rights activist, reveals in a powerful podcast interview.Key Points: Despite legal actions and settlements, many Black farmers have not received promised debt relief, continuing the cycle of land loss. Concerns are raised about the increasing foreign ownership of American farmland, particularly by China, and the influence of wealthy individuals like Bill Gates on the agricultural sector. Boyd expresses a commitment to advocating for the rights and support of all farmers, emphasizing the importance of agriculture to national well-being and security. | | | ---|--- | []() | ---|--- | ---|--- Copyright © 2024 KENNEDY24. Education is a gateway to self-advancement, innovation, and success, but none of that would be possible without the work of our teachers.

Across America, teachers provide their students with the essential tools to become educated and engaged citizens. Far too often, teachers spend money out of their own pockets to ensure their classrooms have everything their students need. That’s why I’m proud to have introduced bipartisan legislation like the Supporting Early-Childhood Educators’ Deductions (SEED) Act to make sure that tax deductions for school supplies are available to all teachers, including early childhood educators. Through legislation like the SEED Act, we can support our educators as they have supported us.

The efforts of educators are the stepping stones to success, and while we can’t thank them enough, we can certainly try.

Thank you for opening this email. In a world where political noise drowns out the voices of hard working Americans like us, **your attention means everything.**

**Did you know that only a fraction of supporters open these emails, and even fewer take action?** Yet, it's individuals like you and me, who understand the challenges our communities face who hold the power to make a difference.

With your support, we can surpass all of our goals and make a real difference.

I've witnessed the decline of American manufacturing and the struggles of hardworking families like mine. Despite the challenges, my grandmother, **Mamaw** , was my rock, guiding me with her tough love and unwavering faith.

Mamaw's tough love and unwavering faith shaped my character, instilling values of hard work, perseverance, and family. Despite challenges, her belief in the American dream inspired me to strive for a better future. **Today, as a U.S. Senator for Ohio, I honor Mamaw's legacy by fighting for hardworking families and ensuring opportunities for all Ohioans.**

Peter, one of my proudest moments in Congress might not be one that you'd expect.
I'd like to tell you more about this, but if you're ready to close out of your email for the day, before you do, **[can I ask you to chip in $10 to help us protect our Democratic Senate majority?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84655899/472203969/-1447414995?&amount=10&source=LOC_EM_FR_2024.05.09_B1_Airplanes_200DO_RS_Exp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NWVlMWIyMi01MTBlLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-5qMhRrjzcDFEsIsOog0slK4kuV-8S_eoZovLPYPuBc=)**
**[CHIP IN $10 →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84655900/472203970/-1447414995?&amount=10&source=LOC_EM_FR_2024.05.09_B1_Airplanes_200DO_RS_Exp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NWVlMWIyMi01MTBlLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-5qMhRrjzcDFEsIsOog0slK4kuV-8S_eoZovLPYPuBc=)**
In 1987, at the beginning of my third term as representative, my office drafted and passed landmark legislation that banned smoking on short domestic flights. Two years later, this law applied to all domestic flights.
On its face, this may seem like a trivial thing to herald as one of my proudest moments, but it had significant personal meaning to me. When I was 14, I lost my dad to lung cancer. He was only 53. I knew that no family should have to experience the loss that we did.
Even if you weren't a smoker, studies pointed to the negative effects of secondhand smoke in confined spaces. I'm proud that my legislation began the movement to ban smoking in public places like hospitals, schools, and restaurants. The Big Tobacco industry fought us hard, but we won.
Throughout my career, I've put the well-being of folks in Illinois and across the country first. I know that this election is no different.

Diversification is your shield against financial uncertainty. By incorporating precious metals into your investment strategy, you strengthen your portfolio and safeguard your financial future.

Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.

**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
A huge congratulations to our legislators for surviving the 2024 legislative session... You did it! I just wanted to personally thank each and every one of them, and all of you who fought for your voice to be heard, for the very hard work put into this years' General Assembly. Thank you for your resilience, perseverance, and patriotism. We are so proud of what you were able to accomplish -- all the wins, big and small -- now... you can go get some sleep 😉
This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, May 9, 2024.
- Heidi Ganahl

**[Want real property tax relief? Stay tuned for ballot initiatives in November.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE STAFF](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
A bill passed yesterday, touted as the answer to skyrocketing property taxes, [does NOT cut property taxes](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Instead of paying an effective rate of 6.3% this year, you'll be paying 6.8% next year.
Colorado lawmakers wrapped up their 2024 legislative session Wednesday evening by sending Gov. Jared Polis a last-minute property tax relief bill, [Senate Bill 233](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Introduced on Monday after months of negotiations, this was one of the final bills to pass before the Assembly adjourned for the year. Lawmakers hope the measure will dissuade voters from backing property tax measures on the November ballot that could significantly impact state and local government budgets. Colorado Concern, the group ready to push a ballot initiative, didn't get on board.
Senate Bill 233 is touted as cutting taxes, but the average homeowner will only see a few hundred dollars annually in "savings" by holding residential and commercial property tax rates steady for this year, affecting taxes owed in 2025. The residential property assessment rate would be set at 6.7%, with a [$55,000 value reduction](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), while commercial properties would see a 27.9% assessment rate and a $30,000 value reduction.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
[Three takeaways from Colorado's 2024 legislative session ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Democrats were able to claim bills were "[bipartisan](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)" by bringing at least one malleable Republican on as a sponsor to get them passed.
* Progressive Democrats' proposals on contentious topics, such as supervised drug consumption facilities and a ban on "assault weapons," faced opposition and [failed to advance](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
* Despite legislative efforts, the [property tax debate continues](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), with a ballot measure proposed by Advance Colorado seeking further reductions in property tax rates and revenue growth caps, highlighting ongoing concerns about property tax relief and fiscal responsibility.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
