**[101 bills debated by the Colorado legislature in 2024 that you need to know about](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Here are the key points from the [Colorado legislature's 2024 session](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) as reported by The Colorado Sun:
* _**Housing Initiatives**_ : Legislation included prohibiting local limits on household compositions ([HB 1007](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)), requiring landlords to have cause for not renewing leases ([HB 1098](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)), and allowing more accessory dwelling units ([HB 1152](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)). Another notable bill, [HB 1313](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), requires zoning changes to boost housing near transit routes.
* **_Gun Control Measures_ :** The state passed laws mandating more rigorous concealed carry permit requirements ([HB 1174](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)), requiring firearms to be stored in locked containers in vehicles ([HB 1348](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)), and proposing a new tax on firearms and ammunition sales ([HB 1349](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)) pending voter approval.
* **_Transportation Improvements_ :** Legislation included a ban on mobile device use while driving ([SB 65](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)) and allowing motorcycles to lane split in specific conditions ([SB 79](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)). Another bill prohibits commercial vehicles from using left lanes on certain mountainous sections of I-70 ([SB 100](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)).
* **_Healthcare Reforms_ :** New laws to expand protections for neurotechnology data ([HB 1058](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)), restrict high-potency sodium nitrite sales ([HB 1081](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)), and require additional syphilis testing for pregnant women ([HB 1456](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)) were passed.
* _**Educational Enhancements**_ : Measures included the creation of Colorado's third medical college ([HB 1231](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)), requirements for free menstrual products in schools ([HB 1164](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)), and new "modern" funding formulas ([HB 1448](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)).
* _**Business and Consumer Protection**_ : Legislation included the right to repair for tech and appliances ([HB 1121](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)) and requirements for clearer fee disclosures by ticket vendors ([HB 1378](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)).
* _**Criminal Justice and Public Safety**_ : Colorado passed laws increasing penalties for human trafficking ([SB 35](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)) and imposing new standards on bail conditions for serious offenses ([House Concurrent Resolution 1002](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)).

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
[Secretary of State announces $894K in grants directed to six county governments ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Six Colorado counties--Arapahoe, Cheyenne, Clear Creek, Dolores, Pueblo, and Yuma--received a total of $894,411 to [digitize and index county records](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), enhancing public access to historical documents.
* [Arapahoe County](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) received the largest portion with $508,288, followed by Pueblo County with $277,963.
* The Electronic Recording Technology Board, established in 2016 and renewed in 2021, aims to support technological upgrades in [land record systems](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), especially benefiting rural Colorado.
* Since its creation, the board has [allocated over $10 million](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to improve county record-keeping systems statewide.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Barron Trump to enter political arena as Florida delegate at GOP convention](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [POLITICO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* [Barron Trump](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), still in high school, has been selected as one of Florida's at-large delegates to the Republican National Convention, marking his entry into the political sphere.

* Other members of the Trump family, including Eric Trump, Donald Trump Jr., Tiffany Boulos, and her husband Michael Boulos, were also chosen as delegates. Eric Trump will serve as the [delegation chair](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and will place his father's name in for the nomination.

* The [Republican National Convention](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) will take place in Milwaukee in July, with the Florida delegation playing a significant role, led by figures such as Evan Power and other notable GOP leaders from Florida.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

**[COMMENTARY: Why on Earth was Colorado's AG at a groundbreaking for a Cargill Housing Development?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY CORY GAINES, [COLORADO ACCOUNTABILITY PROJECT](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)

_The first question I had was why on earth Colorado 's AG would be involved. Local leaders? Cargill big wigs? Yeah. Makes sense._

Instead of paying an effective rate of 6.3% this year, you'll be paying 6.8% next year. Colorado lawmakers wrapped up their 2024 legislative session Wednesday evening by sending Gov. Jared Polis a last-minute property tax relief bill, . Introduced on Monday after months of negotiations, this was one of the final bills to pass before the Assembly adjourned for the year. Lawmakers hope the measure will dissuade voters from backing property tax measures on the November ballot that could significantly impact state and local government budgets. Colorado Concern, the group ready to push a ballot initiative, didn't get on board. Senate Bill 233 is touted as cutting taxes, but the average homeowner will only see a few hundred dollars annually in "savings" by holding residential and commercial property tax rates steady for this year, affecting taxes owed in 2025. The residential property assessment rate would be set at 6.7%, with a , while commercial properties would see a 27.9% assessment rate and a $30,000 value reduction. | Democrats were able to claim bills were "" by bringing at least one malleable Republican on as a sponsor to get them passed. Progressive Democrats' proposals on contentious topics, such as supervised drug consumption facilities and a ban on "assault weapons," faced opposition and . Gun Control Measures : The state passed laws mandating more rigorous concealed carry permit requirements (), requiring firearms to be stored in locked containers in vehicles (), and proposing a new tax on firearms and ammunition sales () pending voter approval. Transportation Improvements : Legislation included a ban on mobile device use while driving () and allowing motorcycles to lane split in specific conditions (). Another bill prohibits commercial vehicles from using left lanes on certain mountainous sections of I-70 (). Business and Consumer Protection : Legislation included the right to repair for tech and appliances () and requirements for clearer fee disclosures by ticket vendors (). Hey, it's Harry.

I cannot believe we're just 5 days from this election.

Between early voting and vote-by-mail, thousands of Marylanders are already making their choice on who is best equipped to protect our democracy and serve MD-03 in Congress.

But MAGA super PACs made their choice a few months ago – and spoiler alert – **_it's not me._**

name: Team Moore
subject: Preparing for the summer
body:
Friend,

Summer is right around the corner. ☀️ Every year, we look forward to spending time with family, heading to the beaches of Ocean City to enjoy the water, enjoying hikes in many of Maryland’s trails, and of course, all the BBQs and outdoor festivities.
As we prepare for longer and warmer days, we’re also preparing our 2024 strategy to ramp up our fundraising.

We’re relying on grassroots supporters like you to help us meet each and every fundraising goal. Your support today will ensure we don’t fall behind and we can catch up after three months of not being able to fundraise.

That’s why we’re asking if you can be one of the donors we need to pitch in now. Wes and the whole team are spending a lot of time focusing on what matters most to Marylanders, so we’re hoping you’ll support their work today by contributing $5 or more today.

You can give at this link » https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20240509-1?refcode=em20240509-1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20240509-1?refcode=em20240509-1]
Wes is fighting for all of us – not just a select few. He spends his time working tirelessly for all Maryland families to realize their potential in this great state.

We can’t thank you enough for supporting this vision.

In gratitude,
Team Moore

#### We have already made the news for our new petitions...
"One of the architects behind the ongoing effort to do away with Alaska’s controversial ranked-choice voting system is already working on two more ballot petitions in a multi-pronged effort to cut down on voter fraud.Phil Izon, who spearheaded a grassroots effort of volunteers in successfully gathering enough signatures to ensure that Alaskans have an opportunity to repeal ranked choice voting this coming November, has written two other petitions that would drastically limit absentee and mail-in voting, while requiring hand-counting of ballots." Step 1: we will need to get our proposed legislation signed and sponsored by 100+ registered voters in Alaska. We already have 125 people signed up to this list, last petition we submitted 180+ signatures. We will provide the document, you need to sign it and then mail it back to us so we can submit them by June 1st. Once we have the 100+ Sponsors we will then submit our two petitions to the Lt. Governor for approval, that process takes 60 days, so by Mid-August we should be collecting signatures. https://www.alaskansforhonestelections.com/future-volunteers-list

Both election related, 1: Require precinct level counting with hand counting, also requires to have tabulation done asap, so we can get election results day of or next day. No more machines. 2\. We are going to modify existing absentee laws so they are only available to a limited population. The new law stipulates that all eligible voters must cast their ballots in person unless they meet certain exceptions such as being 65 years of age or older, disabled, out of the county during the elections, about to give birth, or confined in jail. Many I’ve talk to say my three pieces of Legislation below led by citizen initiative will cut down on 90% of voter fraud. Our elections will be far more Free, Fair, and Honest 1\. Repeal Jungle Primary and RCV 2\. Require Hand Counting at Precinct Level 3\. New law stipulates that all eligible voters must cast their ballots in person unless they meet certain exceptions such as being 65 years of age or older, disabled, out of the county during the elections, about to give birth, or confined in jail. Join me today and help us, we need 1\. Volunteers to help with signature gathering 2\. Advisory board members to help keep us on track 3\. People sharing our messages and get out the vote this November 5th and tell everyone you know hundreds of times to Vote Yes to Repeal. Peter,

Jill's birthday is coming up, and we'd like to invite you to get together with us this Saturday to honor and support an amazing leader who inspires us all! Please join Jill and special guests including Palestinian-American activist Jenan Matari, activist and author Medea Benjamin, Busboys & Poets founder Andy Shallal, Columbia University Professor Anthony Zenkus, and more to support our campaign for an end to endless war and genocide, an economy that works for working people, and a livable future for our children! **RSVP now on our site to receive a Zoom link to join Saturday's event:**

---
With the gravity of world events weighing heavy on us all, Jill didn't want a typical birthday party - so instead we're holding an event to lift up her tireless and heroic fight for a better future for us all. Your support for Jill over the next few days will determine whether every voter across the country will be able to vote against genocide - or not. If you can get together with us Saturday, it would mean a lot to all of us, especially Jill. **Please join us and our special guests this Saturday to honor Jill and power up her fight for people, planet, and peace!**

name: Jon Tester
subject: I wouldn’t be here without Fred and Christine.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gillibrand for Senate
body:
Folks like our teachers, farmers, and construction workers deserve a government that fights for them.
| | |
---
Hi folks.

Here’s a photo of my grandparents, Arnfred and Christine, on their wedding day in 1905. That was a couple years before they picked out a flat piece of grassland just outside Big Sandy to homestead.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84658302/472212233/73003207?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk5027-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZmIxNmY1YS01YjBlLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_57RwDjbT72J5e4rywPALFiofC018o5nVSTBPhpCbxY=)
That patch of loamy, alkaline clay soil is the same one where I grew up, where Sharla and I raised our kids, and where we still farm the land to this day.

Things weren’t easy for Fred and Christine. They suffered devastating windstorms, bitter cold, fires, poisonous snakes—pretty much everything but locusts. They had a couple hundred acres to their name, a newly-built barn, a windmill, their healthy son and daughters (including Helen, my mom), strong muscles, and the powerful work ethic that built rural America.

I first ran for office to make sure our government was serving hardworking Americans like my grandparents. Folks like our teachers, farmers, and construction workers deserve a government that fights for them.

But the special interests trying to unseat me don’t care about that. Dark-money groups are spending millions of dollars to misinform voters and replace me with a mouthpiece for their own agenda. They’ll do whatever it takes to elect their handpicked candidate because they don’t care about protecting our way of life—they’re just in it for power and influence.

body:
| | | | | [](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=d29b4b5bf9&e=3ef74f1f93)

Thank you for your interest in Hogan For Maryland!
First off, a big THANK YOU to everyone who attended or volunteered at our Back to Work BBQ! If you missed it, don’t sweat it–s[ign up for volunteer updates today!](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=cccbf495d2&e=3ef74f1f93)
Another great way to get involved is through a campaign coalition. Hogan for Maryland announced **our first campaign coalition, Veterans for Hogan** , last week. For more information on Veterans for Hogan or how to join or lead a coalition—visit [larryhogan.com/veterans](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=fdd75671db&e=3ef74f1f93) or [https://larryhogan.com/coalitions/](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=f30c36d801&e=3ef74f1f93).
The very best thing you can do to support the Governor is **vote on** **Primary Day, May 14th**. For more information on how to vote in the primary, visit [l**arryhogan.com/vote**](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=68956a3f6a&e=3ef74f1f93). We are also looking for volunteers to work their voting location. If you’d like to volunteer at your poll on the May 14 primary, click [**here**](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=23ef9b9a58&e=3ef74f1f93)!

**Mark Your Calendar:** You are invited to attend the following events with Governor Hogan! Click on each event for more information and to RSVP—we look forward to seeing you there!
* **Monday, May 13th at 4:30 PM:** [Meet and Greet at Valley View Farms in Cockeysville.
](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=c0593baa0d&e=3ef74f1f93)
* **Tuesday, May 14th at 9:00 AM:**[ Join Governor Hogan and his wife, Yumi, as they cast their ballot in Davidsonville.](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=9ddb6b9721&e=3ef74f1f93)

* **Tuesday, May 14th at 7:00 PM:**[ Primary Night Watch at The Crowne Plaza in Annapolis](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=07683529d8&e=3ef74f1f93).

[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=8f68bca6e5&e=3ef74f1f93)
**Back to Work BBQ:** Thank you to the hundreds of supporters who joined the governor and our team for our [**Back to Work BBQ**](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=4957188aa6&e=3ef74f1f93)**** in Davidsonville last Saturday—the rain couldn't stop us!
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=c51410737c&e=3ef74f1f93)
Click [**HERE**](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=b09387fcde&e=3ef74f1f93)**** to watch and share our recap of the Back to Work BBQ.

**Travels Across the State.** Governor Hogan also connected with voters on the Lower Shore with a visit to Somerset and Wicomico counties–with those stops, Hogan for Maryland has officially visited all 24 jurisdictions in Maryland since the start of our campaign!
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=a623f2e0d0&e=3ef74f1f93)
Click [**HERE**](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=434c9dd1d0&e=3ef74f1f93) to view and share.
**Trip to the Southern Border.** In addition to his travels instate, Governor Hogan also took a very important trip to McAllen, Texas where he met with [local law enforcement](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=a54d13d31c&e=3ef74f1f93), [public safety officials](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=5be79c1b80&e=3ef74f1f93), and [toured the Rio Grande](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=fa4e714767&e=3ef74f1f93) to get a firsthand perspective on the crisis at our Southern Border.
[Read more about the governor’s experience at the border](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=4a29071d1e&e=3ef74f1f93).
[Watch the governor’s latest TV ad](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=d80b8d8008&e=3ef74f1f93) calling for bipartisan action to address the border crisis.
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=3001871ee8&e=3ef74f1f93)
Hogan for Maryland was proud to announce the establishment of our inaugural campaign coalition chaired by Brigadier General John “Dragon” Teichert. The coalition’s goal is to unite Maryland veterans around Governor Hogan’s mission and share the governor’s message with veterans.
Click [HERE](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=4d38bbcd3a&e=3ef74f1f93) to learn more about the coalition.
Now, Governor Hogan is looking for more creative ideas to start coalitions and turn out the vote. If you have an idea or want to lead a coalition, visit [https://larryhogan.com/coalitions/](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=3fdd015176&e=3ef74f1f93) to make a suggestion.
In addition to other key issues, Governor Hogan [slammed the antisemitic encampments](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=da6eae3405&e=3ef74f1f93) plaguing college campuses–including Baltimore’s own Johns Hopkins:
_“The antisemitic bigotry, harassment, threats, and lawlessness spreading through these encampments across college campuses is dangerous and must be immediately addressed,”_**Governor Hogan said.**_“What happened at universities like Columbia and UCLA should absolutely not be permitted to happen at Johns Hopkins or any place in Maryland. In 2015, we showed how to handle violent outside extremists and secure peace through strength while protecting the right for Marylanders to peacefully protest. I urge city and state officials and university leaders to follow that proven model and take the necessary steps to put a stop to the chaos on campus.”_
Finally, while visiting the Lower Shore, Governor Hogan took the opportunity to issue a response to the attacks he’s been receiving from both Republicans and Democrats since announcing his candidacy for Senate:

[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=1b5503cb5f&e=3ef74f1f93)
Click [HERE](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=5c2b77c12f&e=3ef74f1f93) to watch and share.
_“Right now, if you turn on your TV, you’ll see one ad attacking me from the left, and another attacking me from the right. The reason why both sides are attacking me is because I’m a threat to status quo politics as usual in Washington,”_**Governor Hogan said.**_“I’m not running to serve one party. I’m running to fight for Maryland and fix the broken politics–just like I did as your Governor. I’ll take the slings and arrows from both sides, but I can’t do this without your support.”_
**With the primary just 5 days away, your support is more important than ever.**
Thank you–and don’t forget to make a plan to vote!
Rob**Team Hogan**

subject: What a second Trump term would look like, in his words

| I’ve been on the frontlines of the efforts to safeguard our institutions from Donald Trump. It’s made me his public enemy number one, but I’ve never backed down from the challenge.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=6423%2E5257348%2EAOJtfz)
Derek, Donald Trump recently gave an extensive interview with _Time Magazine_ to discuss his plans for a second term should he win again this November.
It’s chilling — his plans are more radical and extremist than we could have imagined.
**[Before I elaborate on his dangerous agenda, will you rush in $10 to my campaign to help me continue holding him to account? Trump loathes me and the work I’ve done — and will continue to do — to take him to task for the harm he’s done to our democracy.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=may2024_abs_em.HG8rlH&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240509_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=4&akid=6423%2E5257348%2EAOJtfz)**
[DONATE](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=may2024_abs_em.WQbX9u&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240509_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=6423%2E5257348%2EAOJtfz)
---
Derek, if Trump makes it back to the White House, he’s willing to:
* Pardon _all_ protestors involved in the January 6th insurrection.
* Deport millions of immigrants and build detention camps.
* Fire U.S. Attorneys who go after his political enemies.
* Gut the federal government of civil servants and fill key positions with election deniers.
* Let states monitor women’s pregnancies.
* Back away from supporting crucial American allies.

_The. list. goes. on._
Most terrifyingly, Trump and his advisors are crafting executive orders to give the commander-in-chief _more_ power, doing away with important checks and balances from other branches of government.
You don’t have to be a fear monger, Derek, to take the threat of Donald Trump seriously. You only have to listen to what he says.
Our work starts by making sure voters know what a second Trump administration would really look like. By defending our institutions and shoring up support for our democracy in every way we can.
And by electing people to the Senate to continue to hold Trump to account, whether or not he is back in the White House.
For years, I’ve been on the frontlines of the efforts to safeguard our institutions from Donald Trump. It’s made me his public enemy number one, but I’ve never backed down from the challenge.
Now, as Donald Trump and I will appear on the same ballot this November, I know he will continue to do all he can to bring me down. But with your support, we can stand up to his attacks and continue to hold his feet to the fire.
That’s why I’m urgently asking:
